episodes.description: Marge's old beau, Artie Ziff, now a high-tech billionaire, offers Homer a million dollars if he will let Artie spend a weekend with Marge to try to convince her he made a mistake.

episodes.title: The Bart Wants What It Wants
episodes.description: Bart starts dating Rainier Wolfcastle's daughter, which Homer loves but Bart is not all that thrilled about. When Bart dumps her, and she starts dating Milhouse, Bart travels to Toronto to try to win her back.

episodes.title: The Lastest Gun in the West
episodes.description: Fleeing a dog that hates him for no reason, Bart meets a faded Western star. With Marge's help, Bart tries to get him off booze and start him on a better life.

episodes.title: The Old Man and the Key
episodes.description: To impress a woman he fancies at the senior home, Grampa borrows Homer's car, which he wrecks. He flees with Bart to Branson, Missouri, where the Simpsons encounter forgotten stars of yesteryear.

episodes.title: Tales From the Public Domain
episodes.description: In this retelling of three classic tales from world history, Homer goes on the original Odyssey, Lisa meets a fiery fate as Joan of Arc, and Bart becomes the procrastinating prince of Denmark, Hamlet.

episodes.title: Blame it on Lisa
episodes.description: A huge phone bill leads the Simpsons to discover that Lisa has been sponsoring an orphan in Brazil. Traveling to Rio, they encounter multicolored rats and rampaging monkeys in the episode that offended a nation.

episodes.title: Weekend at Burnsie's
episodes.description: After being attacked by crows, Homer becomes addicted to medicinal marijuana prescribed by Dr. Hibbert. When Homer and his fellow stoners fail to vote in a referendum, the drug is recriminalized and Homer must go cold turkey.

episodes.title: Gump Roast
episodes.description: Two of the great simpletons of contemporary popular culture, Homer Simpson and Forrest Gump, come together in this "clip show" built around highlights from past episodes of The Simpsons.

episodes.title: I am Furious Yellow
episodes.description: Inspired by a highly successful cartoonist who visits his school, Bart creates an embarrassing Internet cartoon, "Angry Dad," based on Homer. Meanwhile, Marvel Comics' Stan Lee visits Comic Book Guy's store -- and won't leave.

episodes.title: The Sweetest Apu
episodes.description: Apu has an affair with a woman who delivers Squishees to his store. The Simpsons try to help him reconcile with his wife.

episodes.title: Little Girl in the Big Ten
episodes.description: Lisa is befriended by college gymnasts who think she is one of them. Meanwhile, Bart is forced to live in a plastic bubble, isolated from the rest of the world.

episodes.title: Frying Game
episodes.description: When Homer attacks a Screamapillar living in his backyard, he is ordered to do community service, where he befriends a needy elderly woman. When she is killed, Homer is blamed for her murder and sentenced to death.

episodes.title: Papa's Got a Brand New Badge
episodes.description: Losing all confidence in the local constabulary, Homer forms his own security company -- Springshield -- which subsequently replaces the police.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XIII
episodes.description: In this three-part episode, Springfield is faced with a hungry horde of Homers, the town bans guns and finally, the people of Springfield become half-human/half-animal monstrosities.

episodes.title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
episodes.description: When a hidden camera films Homer during a cab ride, he confesses his resentment that his family came between him and his rock 'n' roll dreams. To his surprise, Marge enrolls him in an adult rock 'n' roll fantasy camp run by Mick Jagger and Keith Richards. But, in Homer, the rock stars have met their match in violent decadence.

episodes.title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. 3rd Grade
episodes.description: Bart is demoted to third grade while Lisa is advanced to the same class. They are both extremely unhappy with the situation, which is exacerbated when they are made "buddies" on a field trip to the state capital.

episodes.title: Large Marge
episodes.description: Marge accidentally gets implants that feminize her Olive Oyl figure, and decides to leave them in. Meanwhile, Bart and Milhouse imitate unsafe behavior they saw Krusty display on an old TV show, and Krusty must come up with a way to rehabilitate his image. He decides to stage a rescue from a rampaging elephant, but when the elephant gets out of control, Marge's new knockers come to the rescue.

episodes.title: Helter Shelter
episodes.description: When the Simpson home is tented for termites, they agree to go on a reality show in exchange for a place to live. The show forces the Simpsons to live as people did a hundred years ago, and the horror of it nearly splits the nuclear family apart.

episodes.title: The Great Louse Detective
episodes.description: When someone attempts to murder Homer at a free weekend spa vacation, the police go to Sideshow Bob to help find the culprit. Working with the Simpsons, Bob discovers a surprising enemy from the family's past -- then must decide if he wishes to exact a revenge of his own.

episodes.title: Special Edna
episodes.description: Bart tries to cheer up a dejected Mrs. Krabappel by entering her in a competition for Teacher of the Year. Surprisingly, she is nominated, and invited to the ceremony at EFCOT Center. Skinner follows, afraid that they may break up, and they reconcile with the help of Little Richard.

episodes.title: The Dad Who Knew Too Little
episodes.description: When Homer gives Lisa an inappropriate birthday gift, he realizes how little he knows about his daughter. He hires a private detective to get information on her, but when Homer tries to stiff the P.I. for expenses, he and Lisa are framed for a crime they didn't commit.

episodes.title: The Strong Arms of The Ma
episodes.description: A terrifying mugging makes Marge afraid to leave the house. She starts to lift weights to regain her confidence, but an addiction to steroids proves even more harmful than her agoraphobia.

episodes.title: Pray Anything
episodes.description: When Ned Flanders wins a huge sum of money at a WNBA game, Homer decides that the power of prayer can answer any problem. Homer finds that all his prayers are indeed answered, and, in fact, he is given the deed to the church. Living in the church, Homer becomes more and more sacrilegious, until a cleansing rain -- perhaps from God himself -- makes matters right.

episodes.title: Barting Over
episodes.description: Bart learns that he was once a child star whose earnings were squandered by Homer. Bart sues to become legally emancipated and Homer can only win him back with the help of skateboarding legend Tony Hawk.

episodes.title: I'm Spelling as Fast as I Can
episodes.description: Lisa wins the state spelling finals, and is invited to the Spellympics, hosted by Renaissance man George Plimpton. Meanwhile, Homer is preoccupied with following a rib sandwich around participating Krusty Burger franchises.

episodes.title: A Star is Born-Again
episodes.description: When a left-handed movie star wanders into Ned Flanders' store, a romance blossoms. They spend an incredible night together, then Ned informs her that if she wants more of his milk, she'll have to buy the cow.

episodes.title: Mr. Spritz Goes To Washington
episodes.description: When the airport designs a new flight path right over the Simpsons' home, the family convinces Krusty to run for Congress to remedy the situation. Once in Washington, Krusty is shocked to discover the system is corrupt.

episodes.title: C.E.D'oh
episodes.description: On a lonely Valentine's Day evening, Homer attends a life-altering seminar, which teaches him to take a more aggressive course towards success. He becomes the head of the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant, only to discover how lonely the life of the man at the top truly is.

episodes.title: 'Scuse Me While I Miss The Sky
episodes.description: A documentary filmmaker comes to Springfield Elementary and turns Bart and Lisa's worlds topsy-turvy. Bart decides he needs to steal mobster Fat Tony's hood ornament to prove that he's "cool," while Lisa tries to reduce the creeping threat of light pollution.

episodes.title: Three Gays of the Condo
episodes.description: Homer discovers that Marge intended to break up with him while they were dating and is so upset he moves in with two gay roommates. Marge wins him back with the help of "Weird Al" Yankovic -- and alcohol poisoning.

episodes.title: Dude, Where's My Ranch?
episodes.description: Homer writes a song about Flanders that becomes so popular, the Simpsons leave town to avoid hearing it played. They make it to a dude ranch, where Lisa falls for an older boy, while Homer and Bart get involved in a range war with a herd of beavers.

episodes.title: Old Yeller-Belly
episodes.description: When the cat saves Homer's life during a fire, while the dog flees like a coward, Snowball II becomes a hero and the dog is chained outside the Simpsons' house. There he is discovered by beer magnate H. K. Duff and turned into a corporate spokesmodel. The dog's original owner learns of Santa's Little Helper's success and comes forward to reclaim him.

episodes.title: Brake My Wife, Please
episodes.description: Distracted by his in-car appliances, Homer gets into an accident and has his license suspended. He discovers that walking makes him happier and healthier, until he is hit by a car -- driven by Marge! Homer realizes how much hidden resentment his wife has towards him, and throws her a feast to regain her love.

episodes.title: The Bart of War
episodes.description: Bart and Milhouse discover that Ned Flanders has a secret, valuable Beatles collection -- which they ruin. To provide them with more adult supervision, the boys are placed in separate youth groups -- but when the groups go to war, Bart and Milhouse are turned against each other.

episodes.title: Moe Baby Blues
episodes.description: A traffic jam arising from a once-in-a-century flower emanation causes Maggie to nearly fall in the river, only to be saved inadvertently by Moe. A friendship blossoms between the baby and the bartender, until the Simpsons decide it has gotten too intense, and order Moe not to see their little one any more, breaking his heart.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XIV
episodes.description: In the fearsome fourteenth installment of this annual anthology, Homer becomes Death -- and is ordered to kill Marge, Professor Frink's father goes Zombie on the Nobel Prize ceremony. Also, Bart and Milhouse discover what it's like to stop everything in the universe -- except themselves.

episodes.title: My Mother the Carjacker
episodes.description: Homer's mother returns, and he finally achieves his dream of having her live in his house once more -- only to lose her yet again.

episodes.title: The President Wore Pearls
episodes.description: In this musical, ever-so-slightly based on the life of Evita Perón, Lisa runs for Class President, and is elected -- but when she discovers Skinner's plans to reduce the budget, she leads a student strike and is banished to a school for the gifted and troublesome.

episodes.title: The Regina Monologues
episodes.description: Mr. Burns loses a thousand-dollar bill, and Bart earns enough charging people to see it that he can afford to take the Simpsons to England. While there, like all visitors, they encounter J.K. Rowling, Sir Ian McKellen and Prime Minister Tony Blair -- and then Homer smashes into the Queen's coach and is imprisoned in the Tower of London.

episodes.title: The Fat and the Furriest
episodes.description: Homer creates an enormous disgusting ball of candy, and Marge orders him to take it to the dump. While there he is attacked by a bear, and builds a suit designed to enable him to get revenge on the beast and conquer his fears.

episodes.title: Today I am a Clown
episodes.description: Krusty reveals that he has never been bar mitzvahed, and he agrees to do so as part of a network TV special, with the help of his father and Mr. T. Meanwhile, Homer replaces Krusty on the Sabbath with a talk show featuring him and his friends.

episodes.title: 'Tis the Fifteenth Season
episodes.description: Homer spends all the family Christmas money on an astrolabe, then, inspired by Mr. McGrew's version of "A Christmas Carol" he resolves to become the nicest man in town -- to the irritation of the current nicest man, Ned Flanders.

episodes.title: Marge vs. Singles, Seniors, Childless Couples and Teens, and Gays
episodes.description: A children's concert that Marge takes Maggie to erupts in an Altamont-style riot. The town's reaction leads childless townspeople to protest how much of their taxes go to families, resulting in a climactic ballot measure to decide the direction of Springfield.

episodes.title: I, (Annoyed Grunt)-Bot
episodes.description: In an effort to win his son's love, Homer disguises himself as a robot to enter a violent battle-bot contest, and pays a huge physical price. Meanwhile, Lisa encounters a series of cats that have far less than nine lives.

episodes.title: Diatribe of a Mad Housewife
episodes.description: Homer becomes an ambulance driver, while Marge writes a successful novel in which Homer is the thinly-disguised villain, and Flanders the hero.

episodes.title: Margical History Tour
episodes.description: In this anthology of historical stories, Homer, as Henry VIII, cannot find a wife that will bear him a son, Lisa, as Sacagawea, is the brains behind Lenny Lewis and Carl Clark, and Bart is an Amadeus-inspired, boorishly-behaving Mozart.

episodes.title: Milhouse Doesn't Live Here Anymore
episodes.description: Milhouse moves, and Bart is devastated. Meanwhile, Homer earns a small fortune as a beggar.

episodes.title: Smart and Smarter
episodes.description: Lisa is stunned to discover that Maggie is the smartest one in the family. She runs away to live in the museum and her family must go through a giant human body to rescue her.

episodes.title: The Ziff Who Came to Dinner
episodes.description: After taking the Flanders boys to an inappropriately scary movie, Homer finds Marge's old flame Artie Ziff living in his attic. Artie tries to get Homer to take the fall for his failing high-tech company, but after a dalliance with Selma, he decides to do the right thing.

episodes.title: Co-Dependent's Day
episodes.description: Bart and Lisa are so disappointed by the latest Cosmic Wars movie that they travel to wine country to complain to the filmmaker. During a winery tour, Marge and Homer discover they share a love of drinking, which initially bonds them, but then becomes an alcoholic nightmare for both.

episodes.title: The Wandering Juvie
episodes.description: Bart is sentenced to juvenile hall, where he is shackled to a very tough girl who despises -- and has a crush on -- him.

episodes.title: My Big Fat Geek Wedding
episodes.description: Skinner finally agrees to marry Edna...but gets cold feet and blows the deal. She rebounds with Comic Book Guy, leading to a climactic battle at Comic-Con.

episodes.title: Catch 'Em If You Can
episodes.description: Homer and Marge decide they could really use a break from Bart and Lisa, leading the infuriated kids to follow them on an epic, cross-country chase.

episodes.title: Simple Simpson
episodes.description: When Lisa is humiliated by a judge at a county fair, Homer gets revenge by anonymously pie-ing the villain. He becomes a superhero, until his identity is discovered and his powers abused by Mr. Burns.

episodes.title: The Way We Weren't
episodes.description: In this flashback episode, we learn that Homer and Marge met as kids--an encounter that did not end well. The memory of this meeting threatens to derail their marriage in the present, until Marge learns how much Homer has always loved her.

episodes.title: Bart-Mangled Banner
episodes.description: When Bart inadvertently moons the flag, he becomes a national focus of rage, and the Simpsons are exiled to a post 9-11 secret internment camp.

episodes.title: Fraudcast News
episodes.description: Mr. Burns attempts to control all the media in Springfield, but cannot get his hands on Lisa's little newspaper.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XV
episodes.description: A knock to the noggin of Ned Flanders uncannily enables him to foretell the future -- or does it? A knife-wielding killer roams Victorian London, and a fantastic journey through what can charitably be called the body of Mr. Burns.

episodes.title: All's Fair in Oven War
episodes.description: Havoc erupts when the Simpsons remodel. Bart becomes enthralled by adult magazines -- without the adult part, and remodels his lifestyle accordingly.

episodes.title: Sleeping with the Enemy
episodes.description: Bart and Lisa encounter two terrors of being a kid: Bart is tormented by a bully, whom Marge invites to live in their house, while Lisa fears she can never be thin enough.

episodes.title: She Used to Be My Girl
episodes.description: Marge wonders what her life would have been like had she pursued a career in journalism instead of having a family.

episodes.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
episodes.description: When Bart loses his last baby tooth, he suddenly feels old. He pours himself into a new business, making smart alecky T-shirts for a bizarre, Willy Wonka-ish manufacturer named Goose Gladwell.

episodes.title: Midnight Rx
episodes.description: Mr. Burns throws a party for the power plant workers only to announce he is terminating their prescription drug program. Grampa and the seniors realize their only hope for affordable pills is smuggling drugs from Canada.

episodes.title: Mommie Beerest
episodes.description: When the health inspector dies, Moe discovers his successor is not as friendly. To help Moe save his bar, Marge converts it into an English pub. But Homer begins to fear that Marge and Moe are having an "emotional affair."

episodes.title: Homer and Ned's Hail Mary Pass
episodes.description: Homer develops a business encouraging pro athletes to develop creative taunts, while Ned Flanders is so outraged by the indecency on television, he makes a movie of his own.

episodes.title: Pranksta Rap
episodes.description: Bart is forbidden by his parents from attending a hip-hop concert, but does anyway. To cover up his lie, he pretends to be kidnapped -- and Chief Wiggum takes this as an opportunity to do the best police work of his life.

episodes.title: There's Something About Marrying
episodes.description: An amiable public television journalist finds Springfield to be the most unfriendly town he's ever met. To restore its tourist business, Springfield legalizes gay marriage and Homer becomes an online minister.

episodes.title: On a Clear Day I Can't See My Sister
episodes.description: When Bart embarrasses Lisa during a school field trip, she decides to get a restraining order against him. Bart at first is skeptical but is dismayed at how hard it can be to stay no closer than twenty feet from his sister.

episodes.title: Goo Goo Gai Pan
episodes.description: Selma learns she is going through menopause, with the help of a video narrated by Robert Wagner. Realizing she'll never have a baby of her own, she decides to go to China to adopt a child.

episodes.title: Mobile Homer
episodes.description: After Homer has a disastrous encounter with spiders in the garage, Marge worries about what they'd do for money after Homer is gone. She becomes very penurious, and an aggravated Homer retaliates by purchasing a mobile home.

episodes.title: The Seven-Beer Snitch
episodes.description: A Frank Gehry-inspired concert house proves unpopular when the residents of Springfield discover they hate classical music. Mr. Burns buys the hall, and repurposes it as a prison. Meanwhile, Lisa discovers her cat has a double life.

episodes.title: Future-Drama
episodes.description: In this look at the possible future of the Simpsons, Homer and Marge are separated and Bart is hit on by his fourth-grade teacher. And when Marge starts to date Krusty, Homer retreats to an underwater lair.

episodes.title: Don't Fear the Roofer
episodes.description: Homer keeps putting off fixing a leaky roof. After being nagged by Marge, he is happy to meet a friendly contractor. As time passes, however, the rest of the family begins to doubt if this contractor even exists.

episodes.title: The Heartbroke Kid
episodes.description: The school assigns its vending machine contract to unhealthy snacks, with the mascots "Scammer and Z-Dog." Bart becomes particularly addicted to the sweets, and unusually for a ten-year-old, has a heart attack.

episodes.title: A Star is Torn
episodes.description: Lisa enters a "Li'l Star maker" contest, but is dismayed to discover how tough the competition really is. Homer becomes an overprotective stage parent, so abusive that Lisa fires him. Homer goes to work for Lisa's main competitor, and Lisa wonders just where his heart truly lies.

episodes.title: Thank God It's Doomsday
episodes.description: A film about the rapture convinces Homer the end of the world is near. He draws the rest of Springfield into his beliefs, only to be terribly disappointed when the chosen hour comes and nothing happens.

episodes.title: The Father, The Son, and The Holy Guest Star
episodes.description: Willie releases rats at the Medieval festival, Bart is blamed. He goes to Catholic school, where he befriends a cool priest named Father Sean and, to Marge's dismay, considers converting.

episodes.title: Home Away From Homer
episodes.description: Two sexy young women board at Flanders' house and put their daily, titillating, life online, unbeknownst to Ned. When he learns the town was mocking him behind his back, Flanders decides to move.

episodes.title: The Bonfire of the Manatees
episodes.description: When Homer loans the Simpson home to an adult filmmaker, Marge runs off and meets a handsome, athletic friend to the manatees.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Slept Too Little
episodes.description: A cemetery is opened next to the Simpson house. Lisa grows too afraid to sleep in her own bed.

episodes.title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
episodes.description: Homer throws a chicken pox party, and Milhouse's parents take the first steps towards reconciliation.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
episodes.description: In the 16th Halloween trilogy, a comatose Bart is replaced by a robot; Mr. Burns hunts citizens on his estate; and Springfield falls under a witch's spell that only Maggie can break. Terry Bradshaw and Dennis Rodman have cameos.

episodes.title: Marge's Son Poisoning
episodes.description: Bart grows very close to Marge, then fears he has become a mama's boy. Meanwhile, Homer gets one of his arms incredibly strong.

episodes.title: See Homer Run
episodes.description: Homer's heroics during an emergency (caused by Bart) lead him to join the throng running for mayor when Quimby faces a recall.

episodes.title: The Last of the Red Hat Mamas
episodes.description: Marge joins a group of women, the "Cheery Red Tomatoes", who have a sinister secret. Meanwhile, Lisa discovers a surprisingly enchanting side to Milhouse.

episodes.title: The Italian Bob
episodes.description: When the Simpsons go to Italy to get a car for Burns, they discover that Sideshow Bob has become a beloved small-town mayor.

episodes.title: Simpsons Christmas Stories
episodes.description: The Simpsons appear in three Christmas tales: the story of the birth of Jesus; a world war ii tale featuring Grampa, Mr. Burns, and Santa; and a musical featuring "the nutcracker suite."

episodes.title: Homer's Paternity Coot
episodes.description: Homer suspects that Grampa is not who he seems, and that his true father is a charming British adventurer.

episodes.title: We're on the Road to D'ohwhere
episodes.description: Bart must go to a disciplinary camp in Oregon, but when he is discovered to be on the no-fly list, Homer must drive him cross-country.

episodes.title: My Fair Laddy
episodes.description: Lisa determines to musically make a gentleman out of Groundskeeper Willie.

episodes.title: The Seemingly Never-Ending Story
episodes.description: In this Emmy ®Award-winning episode, the Simpsons, when trapped in a cave, relate a complicated tale of love and money.

episodes.title: Bart Has Two Mommies
episodes.description: A mother ape decides she loves Bart. Meanwhile, Marge grows attached to the Flanders boys.

episodes.title: Homer Simpson, This is Your Wife
episodes.description: In this episode penned by The Office's Ricky Gervais, Homer trades wives with a henpecked British man who falls hard for Marge.

episodes.title: Million Dollar Abie
episodes.description: After a life-threatening crisis, Grampa becomes a bullfighter before he realizes the sport is too grisly for him.

episodes.title: Kiss Kiss Bang Bangalore
episodes.description: Springfield Nuclear outsources to India, and Homer goes mad when he attempts to run the plant.

episodes.title: The Wettest Stories Ever Told
episodes.description: The Simpsons land at Plymouth Rock, Captain Skinner attempts to fend off a mutiny, and a giant wave demolishes a '70s luxury cruise.

episodes.title: Girls Just Want to Have Sums
episodes.description: Springfield Elementary is divided between the boys and the girls, and Lisa sneaks over to the other side in disguise to learn math.

episodes.title: Regarding Margie
episodes.description: Marge loses her memory, and most tragically, forgets why she loves Homer.

episodes.title: The Monkey Suit
episodes.description: Springfield Elementary stops the teaching of evolution.

episodes.title: Marge and Homer Turn a Couple Play
episodes.description: Homer and Marge agree to become marriage counselors for a troubled local ballplayer and his sultry singing wife.

episodes.title: The Mook, the Chef, the Wife and Her Homer
episodes.description: Lisa meets Fat Tony's son, Michael, who wants to be a chef. When Tony is wounded in an attempted hit, Homer takes over as head of the mob.

episodes.title: Jazzy and the Pussycats
episodes.description: After Bart ruins a funeral, a therapist suggests the drums as a harmless outlet for Bart's energies. Bart becomes a terrific drummer, and Lisa is jealous.

episodes.title: Please Homer, Don't Hammer 'em
episodes.description: Marge does carpentry work with Homer posing as her front, because the men in Springfield don't believe women can do carpentry. Meanwhile Bart learns Principal Skinner is allergic to peanuts while Skinner discovers Bart is allergic to shrimp.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
episodes.description: In this annual terror-tastic trilogy, Homer becomes a huge voracious Blob, a legendary Jewish guardian appears at Springfield Elementary and Springfield falls victim to the War of the Worlds hoax.

episodes.title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
episodes.description: Bart signs up to be a soldier when he turns 18. Homer gets him out of it, then signs up for duty himself.

episodes.title: Moe 'N' a Lisa
episodes.description: Lisa discovers that Moe has Bukowski-like poetic talent. She takes him to Wordloaf, a literary conference in Vermont.

episodes.title: Ice Cream of Margie (With the Light Blue Hair)
episodes.description: Homer begins driving an ice cream truck, and Marge, feeling a lack of accomplishment in her life, begins making sculptures from his popsicle sticks.

episodes.title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
episodes.description: In this emmy-nominated episode, Bart is the only kid to show up at Nelson the bully's birthday, and, uncomfortably for Bart, they become friends. Meanwhile Homer wants to spare Lisa the sad ending of a book they are reading together.

episodes.title: Kill Gil (Parts I and II)
episodes.description: When Gil loses his job, he moves in with the Simpsons and doesn't leave. Marge decides she needs to tell him off--which she does, inadvertently ruining his life.

episodes.title: The Wife Aquatic
episodes.description: The Simpsons return to an island Marge loved as a child, which is now run down. Then Homer joins the crew of a doomed ship that gets caught in the perfect storm.

episodes.title: Revenge is a Dish Best Served Three Times
episodes.description: In this non-Halloween trilogy, Homer is the Count of Monte Cristo, Milhouse helps lead the nerds over the bullies, and we see the iconic origin of Bartman.

episodes.title: Little Big Girl
episodes.description: Bart gets a drivers license, and he falls for an older girl from out of town. Meanwhile, Lisa lies about her heritage on a homework assignment.

episodes.title: Springfield Up
episodes.description: In this satire of the acclaimed "Up" series of documentaries, we see the residents of Springfield at key points in their lives.

episodes.title: Yokel Chords
episodes.description: Lisa tutors the Spuckler children, while Bart scares the entire school with a phony tale of terror.

episodes.title: Rome-old and Juli-eh
episodes.description: As predicted in Gump Roast, Grampa marries Selma, while Bart and Lisa wage war with a package delivery service.

episodes.title: Homerazzi
episodes.description: Homer becomes a paparazzo, earning the enmity of Springfield's celebrities. Featuring the debut of the classic "Evolution" couch gag.

episodes.title: Marge Gamer
episodes.description: Homer becomes a soccer referee, while Marge aggravates Bart by joining his violent online game.

episodes.title: The Boys of Bummer
episodes.description: Bart loses a key game for his little league team, and becomes an outcast in the town.

episodes.title: Crook and Ladder
episodes.description: Homer becomes addicted to sleep medication, then joins with Apu, Moe and Principal Skinner to become volunteer firemen.

episodes.title: Stop Or My Dog Will Shoot
episodes.description: Homer gets lost in a cornfield maze, then is saved by Santa's Little Helper, who becomes a police dog, and then is jaded by crime.

episodes.title: 24 Minutes
episodes.description: In this complex satire of 24, Marge has to rush to make the bake sale, Homer must rid himself on unsavory yogurt and the bullies try to stink bomb the school.

episodes.title: You Kent Always Say What You Want
episodes.description: In the 400th episode of the Simpsons, Kent Brockman loses his job for uttering a profanity on air.

episodes.title: He Loves To Fly And He D'ohs
episodes.description: Homer is thrilled to ride on Mr. Burns' private plane to Chicago. It inspires him to get a life coach and apply for a new job.

episodes.title: Homer of Seville
episodes.description: Homer discovers when lying flat on his back he has a beautiful singing voice. He becomes targeted for death by a mysterious groupie.

episodes.title: Midnight Towboy
episodes.description: Homer becomes a tow truck driver to the consternation of others. Meanwhile Marge tries raising Maggie with a controversial child-rearing approach.

episodes.title: I Don't Wanna Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
episodes.description: Marge goes to the bank and is enmeshed in a robbery. She befriends the robber then has second thoughts.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XVIII
episodes.description: Bart befriends an alien only to discover he has evil intents; Marge and Homer, unbeknownst to the others, are professional assassins; Flanders opens a Christian alternative to Halloween haunted houses.

episodes.title: Little Orphan Millie
episodes.description: Milhouse's parents disappear on a cruise. Meanwhile Homer gets in trouble with Marge because he can't remember the color of her eyes.

episodes.title: Husbands and Knives
episodes.description: A new friendlier comic book store opens in Springfield and Comic Book Guy is aghast. Marge becomes a successful businesswoman and Homer is afraid he will dump her.

episodes.title: Funeral for a Fiend
episodes.description: After another of his attempts to kill the Simpsons is foiled, Sideshow Bob is put on trial; during the proceedings Bart accidentally kills his old nemesis.

episodes.title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
episodes.description: In this Emmy-winning episode, Homer cannot remember the events of the previous night, when something terrible happened to Marge and his family disappeared.

episodes.title: E. Pluribus Wiggum
episodes.description: Springfield gets the first in the nation primary and Ralph runs for president, promising to make America great again.

episodes.title: That 90's Show
episodes.description: In this flashback to the era when Homer and Marge were together before Bart was born, Marge is attracted to her professor and Homer sings in a grunge band, Sadgasm.

episodes.title: Love, Springfieldian Style
episodes.description: In this Valentine's-themed show, the Simpsons explore the twisted romantic lives of Bonnie and Clyde, Sid and Nancy and Lady and the Tramp.

episodes.title: The Debarted
episodes.description: Bart befriends a cool older kid only to discover he is a plant working for Principal Skinner.

episodes.title: Dial 'N' for Nerder
episodes.description: Bart and Lisa are afraid they have killed Martin Prince. Meanwhile Marge employs a reality TV show to discover if Homer is cheating on his diet.

episodes.title: Smoke on the Daughter
episodes.description: Lisa takes ballet and becomes addicted to second-hand smoke. Meanwhile Homer and Bart make jerky.

episodes.title: Papa Don't Leech
episodes.description: Homer's former protege Lurleen Lumpkin returns with her no-good hamboning father in tow.

episodes.title: Apocalypse Cow
episodes.description: With the help of Cletus' daughter Mary, Bart raises a prize calf only to be terrified when it is sold for slaughter.

episodes.title: Any Given Sundance
episodes.description: Lisa enters a film in the Sundance festival under the Chalmskin production banner. The documentary proves embarrassing to her family.

episodes.title: Mona Leaves-a
episodes.description: Homer's mother returns to him for good--then dies. To cope with his grief he tries to honor her unusual last wishes.

episodes.title: All About Lisa
episodes.description: The season ends with Mr. Burns losing a penny, just as it began with him finding one. We see the rise of Lisa as Krusty's assistant, narrated by Mel.

episodes.title: Sex, Pies and Idiot Scrapes
episodes.description: Homer is sent to jail after a brawl at the St. Patrick's Day parade. When he goes to get his bail bond, Homer meets Lucky Jim and "Wolf the Bounty Hunter" and decides to try his own hand at the lucrative but deadly profession. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to her, Marge begins working at an erotic bakery.

episodes.title: Lost Verizon
episodes.description: Bart takes a job at a country club and watches celebrities playing golf. When Bart finds Denis Leary's cell phone, he decides to keep the cell and makes prank calls to all over the world pretending to be Leary. After Marge discovers what Bart has done, she calls Leary to return the phone. But he has an idea to activate the GPS system on the phone so Marge can track Bart's every move.

episodes.title: Double, Double, Boy in Trouble
episodes.description: When Lenny wins the lottery and invites the Simpsons to a celebratory party, Bart meets his doppelganger, Simon Woosterfield, who is a member of the richest family in Springfield. Simon and Bart decide to switch places, and Bart arrives at the lavish Woosterfield mansion. As Simon adjusts to the life over at the Simpson household, Bart notices his new siblings acting strangely toward him.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XIX
episodes.description: First, Transformer-like robots duke it out in Springfield. Then Homer kills off celebrities so their likenesses can be exploited free-of-charge. And Lisa accompanies Milhouse to a pumpkin patch to await the appearance of the Grand Pumpkin, but when he finally appears, the Grand Pumpkin goes on a rampage to avenge all the pumpkins carved and tortured in the name of Halloween.

episodes.title: Dangerous Curves
episodes.description: Homer and Marge have a series of flashbacks when they take a trip to a cabin. They recall an encounter with Flanders and Maude 20 years prior at the same cabins, where Flanders insisted Homer and Marge stay in separate rooms. Later, they recall meeting members of the opposite sex who nearly wooed them away from each other. Bart and Lisa also reflect on happier times from their childhood.

episodes.title: Homer and Lisa Exchange Cross Words
episodes.description: Lisa discovers her talent for doing crossword puzzles and becomes an expert cruciverbalist, and she soon enters a citywide crossword puzzle tournament. Homer, short on cash after abandoning his professional break-up artist business, goes to cheer Lisa on and discovers a crossword puzzle betting ring. In the ultimate betrayal, Homer profits from betting against Lisa in the championship match.

episodes.title: Mypods and Boomsticks
episodes.description: The Simpsons take a trip to the mall where Bart interrupts Steve Mobbs with his own voiceover, causing pandemonium. On his way home, Bart narrowly escapes punishment and befriends a Muslim boy named Bashir. Homer becomes suspicious and invites Bashir and his parents over for dinner, where he offends them. Homer goes to their home to apologize, but instead he snoops around their house.

episodes.title: The Burns and the Bees
episodes.description: Mr. Burns wins a basketball team in poker and decides to win over the basketball fans of Springfield by building a sports arena. Unfortunately, Springfield's last bee colony is located on the proposed site and Lisa is spearheading a movement to protect them. Homer attempts to help the bee population by mating the bees with Africanized bees, creating a swarm that disrupts Burns' opening night.

episodes.title: Lisa the Drama Queen
episodes.description: Lisa befriends a highly creative girl who develops a fantasy world only the two of them share. As they go deeper into their make-believe universe, Marge becomes concerned. She forbids Lisa to see her new friend again, but Lisa defies Marge and runs away with Juliet. Lisa discovers that living a life of fantasy is increasingly unpleasant, and in the end is greatly relieved to return to reality.

episodes.title: Take My Life, Please
episodes.description: Homer learns that he was elected class president, but the election was stolen from him by his high school principal. At Luigi's Italian restaurant, Homer meets an old Italian man who can show him visions of what his future as class president would have been like. Homer sees a life he could have led filled with riches and success, and his family must find a way for him to be happy the way he is.

episodes.title: How the Test Was Won
episodes.description: When Springfield Elementary must take the Vice-President's Assessment Test, the superintendent arranges to have all the poor students taken out of school for the day. Principal Skinner is tricked into accompanying the delinquents, and they must work together to find their way back from the heart of Capital City.

episodes.title: No Loan Again, Naturally
episodes.description: The Simpsons spend too much money on an annual Mardi Gras bash, and when the rate on their home equity loan goes up they lose their home. Ned Flanders takes pity on the family and buys their home to rent back to them. When they ask Ned, their new landlord, for excessive repairs, he evicts them. But when a new couple tries to rent the home, a melancholy Ned realizes he misses the Simpsons too much.

episodes.title: Gone Maggie Gone
episodes.description: A rare solar eclipse temporarily blinds Marge. Without her in charge, rats take over the kitchen, and when Homer gets poison to kill them, he must briefly set Maggie down outside a convent, where the nuns take her in. Meanwhile, Lisa uncovers a plot to bring everlasting peace to Springfield, involving a mystical gem, the founding fathers, and Principal Skinner's mother's minivan.

episodes.title: In the Name of the Grandfather
episodes.description: The Simpsons let Grampa down and agree to do one thing he's always wanted. They fly to Ireland to visit a pub Grampa loved as a young man, and wind up buying it, only to find that the Irish no longer want to hang out in pubs. The Simpsons bring Moe over to give them advice, and he suggests they allow smoking in the pub, which runs them afoul of Irish law.

episodes.title: Wedding for Disaster
episodes.description: Homer and Marge discover that due to a problem with Reverend Lovejoy's certification, they are not legally married. Homer tries to give Marge the large, fancy wedding he never could--and then he disappears right before the ceremony. He turns up a captive to a mysterious stranger a la the film "Saw," and Bart and Lisa must uncover who is behind the plot.

episodes.title: Eeny Teeny Maya Moe
episodes.description: Moe meets a woman online who turns out to be three feet tall. He falls in love but finds that his own shortcomings are too great for the relationship to survive. Meanwhile, Homer finds a new playground for Maggie that seems idyllic--until she runs into some baby bullies. Marge suspects that something is wrong, and, with misgivings, decides to electronically pry into Homer's daddy-daughter time.

episodes.title: The Good, The Sad, and The Drugly
episodes.description: Bart meets a sweet fifth-grade girl who makes him pretend to be a goody two-shoes. But when a jealous Milhouse learns of the romance, he threatens to reveal Bart's past. Meanwhile, Lisa becomes depressed at the fate of the world. She is cheered up by an anti-depressant for children, Ignorital, until Marge realizes her daughter has lost too much touch with reality.

episodes.title: Father Knows Worst
episodes.description: Homer observes how poor a student Bart is, and how unpopular Lisa is, so he tries to get more involved with their lives. But he discovers that with his "helicopter parenting", he may have hovered too close to his children's lives. Meanwhile, Marge discovers a sauna in the basement of the Simpson house. Afraid it will be abused if she tells others about it, she keeps it a secret for herself.

episodes.title: Waverly Hills 9-0-2-1-D'oh
episodes.description: A visit to Springfield Elementary convinces Marge the kids need a better school. The Simpsons rent a tiny apartment in an upscale neighborhood to enroll in a better school district. Marge and Homer discover that the intimacy of the apartment rekindles the spark in their marriage, but Lisa discovers that the other students in her new school are not as welcoming as she would have hoped.

episodes.title: Four Great Women and a Manicure
episodes.description: Marge takes Lisa for her first mani-pedi. While there, the two swap stories about powerful women through history: the Virgin Queen, Elizabeth I, who defeated the Spanish Armada; the beautiful and virtuous Snow White; the ambitious and tragic Lady Macbeth; and author of "The Fountainhead", Ayn Rand.

episodes.title: Coming To Homerica
episodes.description: When Krustyburger serves tainted barley, the barley suppliers in Ogdenville are forced out of work. They emigrate to Springfield, where they prove to be hardworking and polite. But as they become more and more a part of Springfield's daily life, Homer and his friends form a border brigade to keep them out, culminating in the building of a wall between the two cities.

episodes.title: Homer the Whopper
episodes.description: Comic Book guy creates a comic book--"Everyman"--whose hero absorbs the power of any comic book he touches. Homer is cast in the lead, and gets physically fit with the help of a personal trainer. But when the trainer leaves for another job, Homer regains the weight he lost, wreaking havoc on the film.

episodes.title: Bart Gets A 'Z'
episodes.description: When Bart tries to loosen up his teacher by spiking her coffee, he gets her so drunk she loses her job. He tries to make it up to her by helping her open a muffin store, but she discovers the truth. Meanwhile, her replacement turns out to be a cool young teacher who can work the internet.

episodes.title: The Great Wife Hope
episodes.description: When all the males in Springfield become addicted to a violent TV sport, Marge agrees to fight the founder of the league in hopes of getting it off the air. Worried that she may not survive, Homer makes sure she trains with the toughest men in Springfield. She toughens up and is able to take a sucker punch and win.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XX
episodes.description: In this annual terror-themed thrilled, Dracula and the Wolfman walk the streets of Springfield, Bart and Lisa cause carnage in the school in a Hitchcock-themed segment, Krusty's new hamburger made from mad cows turns the town into zombies, and Moe falls for Marge in a creepy broadway musical--but can only win her over by serving her beer mixed with Homer's blood.

episodes.title: The Devil Wears Nada
episodes.description: Homer becomes his buddy Carl's assistant. Carl is a demanding Anna Wintour-type boss whose demands fill Homer's life. When Marge inadvertently does cheesecake poses for a charity calendar, it only makes matters worse. Homer realizes he must choose between the jetsetting life of a power plant supervisor's aide and saving his marriage.

episodes.title: Pranks and Greens
episodes.description: Bart discovers there was an even more awesome prankster than he, and determines to track him down, only to find he is a sad loser living in his mother's house. Meanwhile, Marge's attempts to provide truly healthy food for Maggie and her friends lead only to frustration.

episodes.title: Rednecks and Broomsticks
episodes.description: Lisa joins a group of teenage wiccans, while Homer becomes a moonshine aficionado. When half the town goes blind from the moonshine, they blame the witches, and try them according to ancient Springfield laws.

episodes.title: O Brother, Where Bart Thou?
episodes.description: Bart realizes that Lisa has a bond with Maggie that he will never have, because he has no brother. After a dream about famous brothers from Wright to Mario, Bart tries to adopt one, but finds having a brother can bring as much pain as pleasure.

episodes.title: Thursdays with Abie
episodes.description: Grampa meets a newspaper columnist who chronicles his life in the local paper. It causes a rift between Homer and his father, and Homer begins to suspect the writer has a secret, sinister motive. Meanwhile, Bart takes home a beloved class doll, and Lisa loses it down a sewer.

episodes.title: Once Upon A Time in Springfield
episodes.description: Krusty gets a new sidekick - a Disney-style princess who proves too popular for Krusty's liking. But when he tries to fire her, he finds she is more attached to him than he ever dreamed. Meanwhile, when Mr. Burns eliminates the donuts from the power plant break room, Homer and his friends consider working at another power plant.

episodes.title: Million Dollar Maybe
episodes.description: Homer wins a million dollars in the lottery, but bought the ticket while he was supposed to be helping his wife, so he can't spend the money without her getting furious at him. When Bart learns of Homer's secret, he threatens to tell Marge unless Homer does whatever he wants.

episodes.title: Boy Meets Curl
episodes.description: A planned evening of ice skating and a chance encounter introduces Marge and Homer to the sport of curling, and they wind up joining a team and becoming involved in the Olympic trials.

episodes.title: The Color Yellow
episodes.description: While researching her family tree, Lisa discovers the diary of an ancestor that reveals the Simpson family was in the underground railroad before the Civil War. After further investigation she is shocked to learn that her ancestors were not what they seem.

episodes.title: Postcards From the Wedge
episodes.description: When Bart realizes he can exploit Marge and Homer's differences, it nearly breaks their marriage apart. And when he discovers an abandoned subway underneath Springfield, it nearly breaks the town apart.

episodes.title: Stealing First Base
episodes.description: Bart meets a girl with whom he is alternately infatuated and infuriated. His furtive kiss creates a ban on public displays of affection in the school. Meanwhile, Lisa discovers she has a secret supporter, who turns out to be surprisingly successful.

episodes.title: The Greatest Story Ever D'ohed
episodes.description: Hoping to make Homer more religious, Ned Flanders invites the Simpsons on a trip to the Holy Land. There they meet an angry Israeli tour guide and Homer comes to believe he is the messiah.

episodes.title: American History X-cellent
episodes.description: An office party at Mr. Burns' mansion turns into a drunken riot--landing Burns in jail. In prison, a deeply religious convict takes Burns under his wing and tries to make a good man of him.

episodes.title: Chief of Hearts
episodes.description: Homer befriends Chief Wiggum, but when Wiggum saves his life, the friendship gets too close for Homer's comfort. Meanwhile, Bart gets addicted to a Japanese card/robot/adventure game.

episodes.title: The Squirt and the Whale
episodes.description: Homer attempts to power the house with a wind turbine. After a freak windstorm knocks out the turbine, a whale washes up on shore, and the town attempts to save it.

episodes.title: To Surveil With Love
episodes.description: When Homer's unattended bag causes a bomb scare at Springfield Union station, the town introduces draconian security measures. Surveillance cameras are installed all over town, and the only unsupervised spot is in the Simpsons' back yard. Meanwhile, Lisa encounters discrimination because she is a blonde.

episodes.title: Moe Letter Blues
episodes.description: A mysterious letter leads Homer, Apu and Reverend Lovejoy to suspect their marriages are in serious trouble. Examining the past leads each to believe his wife has run off with Moe the bartender.

episodes.title: The Bob Next Door
episodes.description: The Simpsons get a new next door-neighbor, who, despite all appearances, Bart believes to be SIDESHOW BOB! He uncovers the shocking truth and a desolate spot where five states meet.

episodes.title: Judge Me Tender
episodes.description: Moe proves himself so witty and acerbic judging an Ugly Dog contest he is invited to Los Angeles to judge American Idol. There he befriends Simon Cowell and learns a lesson about show business.

episodes.title: Elementary School Musical
episodes.description: Lisa gets a dream week at arts camp where her counselors are Flight of the Conchords, then finds her return to the real world is more than a little disheartening. Meanwhile, Krusty discovers winning the Nobel Peace prize is not what it seems, and he must fight for his freedom in the World Court.

episodes.title: Loan-A-Lisa
episodes.description: Grampa decides to give each of the Simpsons their inheritance early. Homer discovers he can live the high life buying and returning luxury items without paying for them. Lisa uses her money to secretly finance Nelson's bike pimpery.

episodes.title: Money Bart
episodes.description: Lisa coaches Bart's little league team to beef up her extracurricular-activities résumé, but her academic approach to the game takes some of the fun out of it for Bart.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
episodes.description: In this annual terror-filled trilogy, the old board games in the Simpson attic come to life and wreak havoc in Springfield, Marge and Homer's romantic cruise is interrupted by a mysterious, handsome stranger who Homer believes is trying to kill them, and Lisa falls in love with a tweenage vampire, only to run afoul of his old-school vampire father.

episodes.title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
episodes.description: A trip to Marge's childhood home leads Lisa to discover that Marge was once an excellent student like her, until she met Homer. Meanwhile, Bart accidentally beats up Nelson and becomes the school bully--much to his chagrin.

episodes.title: The Fool Monty
episodes.description: During a "housecat flu" scare, Mr. Burns is startled to discover that everyone in town hates him. He tries to take his own life, but fails, losing his memory in the process. The townspeople use the opportunity to seek revenge on him for the harm he has inflicted upon them through the years.

episodes.title: How Munched is that Birdie in the Window?
episodes.description: A storm blows a pigeon through the Simpsons' window, and Bart makes it his pet. He nurses it back to health, and when he is approached by Moe to turn it into a racing pigeon he has to make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: The Fight Before Christmas
episodes.description: Bart heads to a surprisingly downsized North Pole to get a toy he wants; Marge attempts to kill Hitler at Christmas, Martha Stewart takes over the Simpson family holiday, and Katy Perry performs with the Simpsons--in puppet form for the first time ever.

episodes.title: Donnie Fatso
episodes.description: When Homer runs afoul of tough new ordinances that take effect January 1, he goes undercover with the mob to shorten his sentence. He finds that the Springfield Mafia is much more welcoming and lovable than he ever would have suspected.

episodes.title: Moms I'd Like To Forget
episodes.description: A war between the fourth and fifth graders leads Bart to discover an unusual scar on his wrist. Learning the secret of its origin unlocks a secret from Marge's past. Bart's journey to the truth takes him to Comic Book Guy, and a Fourth of July long ago gone horribly wrong.

episodes.title: Flaming Moe
episodes.description: To impress Mr. Burns, Smithers helps Moe turn his tavern into a gay bar that caters to men who are less than perfect. Meanwhile, a substitute music teacher becomes the passion of Principal Skinner's life. Moe enjoys his new clientele so much he considers running for city council. Meanwhile, Principal Skinner must choose between his career and a free-spirited substitute music teacher.

episodes.title: Homer the Father
episodes.description: Homer becomes obsessed with a cheesy '80s sitcom and tries to apply its outdated lessons to his own relationship with Bart. A disgruntled Bart is driven straight into the arms of Chinese nuclear spies.

episodes.title: The Blue and the Gray
episodes.description: When Marge decides to "go gray" with her hair, she is startled by the reaction of her friends and family. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a "wing man", first to Moe, then to every single guy in town.

episodes.title: Angry Dad: The Movie
episodes.description: Bart makes an animated short film which is surprisingly nominated for every major Hollywood award. When Homer tries to seize credit for the film, it starts a battle between the two that climaxes onstage at the Academy Awards.

episodes.title: The Scorpion's Tale
episodes.description: Lisa discovers a miraculous drug that can cure crankiness in old people. Bart starts illegally selling it to Springfield seniors, only to discover it has a horrifying side effect.

episodes.title: A Midsummer's Nice Dreams
episodes.description: When Cheech and Chong split up during a performance in Springfield, Homer gets a chance to perform stoner comedy--but finds it is not the high life he imagines. Meanwhile, Marge attempts to cure the crazy Cat Lady of her hoarding.

episodes.title: Love is a Many Strangled Thing
episodes.description: When Homer reveals in therapy that he has strangled Bart for years, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar is brought in to effectuate a cure. Homer becomes so intimidated by his son that Bart starts to run wild, terrorizing his father and the school.

episodes.title: The Great Simpsina
episodes.description: While trying to get rid of a wagonful of unwanted peaches, Lisa encounters an again magician who teaches her long-forgotten tricks. Then she unwittingly betrays his secret to a hated young rival.

episodes.title: The Housewives of Fat Tony
episodes.description: Selma's behavior at the DMV leads to an unexpected romance with Fat Tony, and a trip to see Tony's relatives on the Jersey shore. Meanwhile, Lisa discovers Bart has truffle-sniffing abilities previously seen only in pigs--abilities which lead him to be exploited by his sister.

episodes.title: Homer Scissorhands
episodes.description: Homer discovers his natural gift for hairstyling. But he finds that the women in Springfield tell him more about their men than he wants to know. Meanwhile, Milhouse publicly declares his love for Lisa, is rejected, then is stunned to discover someone who likes him as much as he likes her. An equally stunned Lisa becomes obsessed with finding out just what Milhouse's new girlfriend sees in him.

episodes.title: 500 Keys
episodes.description: The family discovers 500 old keys in a drawer and tries to find out what they do. Marge sets a farting novelty toy loose on the town, Homer achieves a lifelong dream as he pilots the Duff blimp, Bart is dismayed to find that every prank he tries to pull turns into a good deed, and Lisa uncovers a shocking mystery in the basement of the school.

episodes.title: The Ned-liest Catch
episodes.description: Ned Flanders saves Edna Krabappel's life and they begin dating. To Ned's surprise, he learns that Edna has been with many of Springfield's men, including Homer and Aerosmith drummer Joey Kramer.

episodes.title: The Falcon and the D'ohman
episodes.description: There is a new Springfield nuclear employee with a mysterious past--that Homer tries to uncover. Homer discovers his new friend is a former undercover agent--whose enemies realize they can flush out by kidnapping Homer. Also, Nedna, the result!

episodes.title: Bart Stops to Smell the Roosevelts
episodes.description: Superintendent Chalmers takes a special interest in Bart, and discovers he can reach him through study of our 26th president. Chalmers is fired after taking Bart and his friends on an unauthorized camping trip and Bart and his rough riders saddle up to win the superintendent's job back.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXII
episodes.description: A paralyzed Homer can only communicate by passing gas--but discovers it makes him a better man, a vengeful Flanders becomes a killer from the Lord--only to discover that the "voice from above" is actually coming from somewhere else, and Bart takes the form of a powerful alien being on an exotic but deadly garden planet.

episodes.title: Replaceable You
episodes.description: Bart's science fair project, a realistic little robot seal, unexpectedly brings joy to Springfield's elderly. Meanwhile, a new coworker disrupts Homer's peaceful life at the plant. He is in danger of losing all, until Ned Flanders reveals his foe's secret weakness.

episodes.title: The Food Wife
episodes.description: When she gets lost in an unfamiliar ethnic neighborhood, Marge discovers the joy of exotic food. It becomes a new activity for her and the kids, until Homer gets jealous and Marge inadvertently sends him to a crackhouse.

episodes.title: The Book Job
episodes.description: Homer and Bart try to defraud a publishing house, Ocean's Thirteen-style. They settle on Lisa as the unhappy front for their operation, and are aided by a surprisingly compliant Neal Gaiman.

episodes.title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
episodes.description: Homer becomes an "accounts man" at the nuclear plant but finds the job leads him to a life of alcohol and loneliness. Finally Marge forces him to choose between a boatful of boozy clients and his own sweet flesh and blood.

episodes.title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
episodes.description: The Simpsons encounter a venerable TV agent and are stunned to discover she gave Krusty her start. Now they need her to help him again--but her bitterness at their breakup stands in the way.

episodes.title: Holidays Of Future Passed
episodes.description: At a Simpson Christmas thirty years in the future Bart and Lisa discover the perils of parenthood in a post-apocalyptic world. Meanwhile Maggie creates a miracle of her own.

episodes.title: Politically Inept, With Homer Simpson
episodes.description: Homer becomes a blowhard TV pundit and attempts to select our next president. Ted Nugent teaches him the true meaning of the Constitution.

episodes.title: The D'oh-cial Network
episodes.description: When Lisa can't make friends in person she tries to do so with an online network. The effect on Springfield is so ruinous she is put on trial.

episodes.title: Moe Goes From Rags To Riches
episodes.description: The story of western civilization is recounted by Moe's bar rag. More significantly, Milhouse decides he's had just about enough of being Bart's patsy.

episodes.title: The Daughter Also Rises
episodes.description: Lisa meets a boy who seems to be the reincarnation of Ernest Hemingway, but turns out to be less than he appears. Meanwhile, Bart and Milhouse debunk myths at school, to the dismay of their fellow students.

episodes.title: At Long Last Leave
episodes.description: In the long-awaited Simpsons 500th Episode, the town of Springfield banishes the Simpsons for everything they've done over the years. The Simpsons move off the grid, but Marge misses their home and friends.

episodes.title: Exit Through The Kwik-E-Mart
episodes.description: When Homer punishes Bart by sticking him in a rabbit cage, Bart retaliates by making Homer's face an iconic graffiti image throughout Springfield.

episodes.title: How I Wet Your Mother
episodes.description: Following a traumatic incident, Homer's bed-wetting problem worsens, and his family decide to infiltrate his dreams to get to its subconscious source. And in Homer's dreams is where his late mother resides.

episodes.title: Them, Robot
episodes.description: To avoid litigation from radiation exposure, Mr. Burns replaces every worker in the nuclear plant except Homer with a robot. Homer experiences a savage isolation when he tries unsuccessfully to befriend his non-human coworkers.

episodes.title: Beware My Cheating Bart
episodes.description: Jimbo's girlfriend falls for Bart after he's forced to chaperone her to a movie. School bullies notice, and that's bad for Bart. Meanwhile, Homer is persuaded to buy an exercise machine, but doesn't have to be persuaded to use the TV that comes with it.

episodes.title: A Totally Fun Thing Bart Will Never Do Again
episodes.description: Bart pesters the family into going on a cruise vacation. They even luck into a luxury suite. Now all Bart needs to do is figure out a way to make it last longer than a week.

episodes.title: The Spy Who Learned Me
episodes.description: After being injured at work, Homer is given eight weeks of paid vacation... and decides to keep the news secret from his family; Bart gets Nelson hooked on Krustyburgers so he'll gain weight and stop picking on him.

episodes.title: Ned 'n Edna's Blend Agenda
episodes.description: When a crucified Homer sends Ned to the hospital we learn that his relationship with Edna had gone further than we knew. Then a fight over the right school for the kids sends Ned packing to the Simpsons'.

episodes.title: Lisa Goes Gaga
episodes.description: Lisa has an internet defender who is not what he seems. Then Lady Gaga arrives and makes everyone in town feel like a little monster--except Lisa.

episodes.title: Moonshine River
episodes.description: Bart realizes that the girls he's liked all dump him within a week. To prove he can be loved, he journeys to New York and seeks out a former flame. Meanwhile, Marge and Lisa's search for cheap culture leads them to perform impromptu Shakespeare in the park.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXIII
episodes.description: A search for the Higgs Boson creates a black hole that sucks in Springfield until it is stopped by a most unlikely hero. Found footage reveals a demonic deal from the Simpsons' past comes back to terrorize them in the present and Bart learns what life would have been like if Homer hadn't taken Marge to the prom. Also, the end of the world as foretold by the ancient Mayans.

episodes.title: Adventures in Baby-getting
episodes.description: A sinkhole destroys Marge's car and when she gets a more compact replacement she realizes she wants a baby. Meanwhile, Lisa mysteriously vanishes every day after school and the only clue is "boxing wizards".

episodes.title: Gone Abie Gone
episodes.description: Grampa disappears, and while trying to find him they learn he had a second wife.

episodes.title: Penny-Wiseguys
episodes.description: Fat Tony names his accountant head of the mob, and then asks him to kill members of the gang. Meanwhile, vegetarian Lisa starts eating bugs, until she realizes they are a gateway to shrimp.

episodes.title: A Tree Grows in Springfield
episodes.description: A depressed Homer wins a myPad and the tablet changes his life--until it breaks. Then he receives new hope from a most unlikely source.

episodes.title: The Day the Earth Stood Cool
episodes.description: Portland comes to Springfield in the form of Homer's new hipster neighbors. While Homer loves the designer donuts, Marge is none too crazy about the breast-feeding mafia.

episodes.title: To Cur, With Love
episodes.description: While playing a civilization-building Internet game, Homer loses the family dog. Grampa reveals that Homer himself had a dog as a boy--one that he had to give up.

episodes.title: Homer Goes to Prep School
episodes.description: A trip to a childrens' playhouse turns into a near-death experience for Homer. He meets preppers who help him get ready for the imminent end of the world.

episodes.title: A Test Before Trying
episodes.description: Bart must pass a test to save Springfield Elementary. Meanwhile, Homer finds a working parking meter and uses it to steal quarters beyond his wildest dreams.

episodes.title: The Changing of the Guardian
episodes.description: Marge and Homer nearly suffocate in a revolving door during a tornado. They realize they do not have suitable guardians for their children.

episodes.title: Love is a Many-Splintered Thing
episodes.description: Love is a Many-Splintered Thing. Bart looks back at love from middle age in this homage to Annie Hall.

episodes.title: Hardly Kirk-ing
episodes.description: Bart and Milhouse discover that they can convince everyone Milhouse is his dad. Meanwhile, Homer discovers a hidden talent for finding hidden pictures.

episodes.title: Gorgeous Grampa
episodes.description: The Simpsons discover Grampa was a "bad guy" pro wrestler in the '50s. Then they are alarmed to see Bart begin to adopt Grampa's worst qualities.

episodes.title: Black-Eyed, Please
episodes.description: Lisa gets picked on by a bully who happens to be her teacher, and cannot figure out the reason why. Meanwhile, Flanders finally gets fed up and punches Homer in the eye--then desperately begs his neighboreeno for forgiveness Homer won't provide.

episodes.title: Dark Knight Court
episodes.description: Springfield's Easter is ruined by a prank and all fingers point to Bart. It is up to Lisa to save her brother, in a student court presided over by Attorney General Janet Reno. Meanwhile, inspired by an old comic book, Mr. Burns becomes an ineffectual superhero--fruit bat man.

episodes.title: What Animated Women Want
episodes.description: A fight during a long-planned lunch prompts Homer to learn the four f's of dealing with a woman. Meanwhile Milhouse discovers the secret to Lisa's heart in an old black-and-white film.

episodes.title: Pulpit Friction
episodes.description: After a terrifying bedbug scare, a new teacher comes to Springfield Presbylutheran and wins the congregation's affections--sending Reverend Lovejoy into the unholy world of hot tub sales.

episodes.title: Whiskey Business
episodes.description: A suicide attempt gone awry prompts Marge to buy Moe a fancy new suit to improve his outlook on life. He starts a homemade bourbon brewery and gets an IPO at the Springfield stock exchange -- then loses the suit that got him there.

episodes.title: The Fabulous Faker Boy
episodes.description: Bart takes piano lessons because his teacher is a beautiful young girl. But he disappoints his mother with his lack of talent at a recital. Meanwhile, Homer loses his top two hairs and becomes completely bald.

episodes.title: The Saga of Carl
episodes.description: When the guys split a winning lottery ticket, they are stunned when Carl disappears with the money. In tracking him down, they discover surprising secrets about his past.

episodes.title: Dangers on a Train
episodes.description: When Marge tries to buy Homer snack cakes for their anniversary, she winds up meeting a married man who shares a common love of British Television. Ignorant of all, Homer attempts to secretly construct a romantic anniversary train in the Simpsons back yard.

episodes.title: Homerland
episodes.description: Homer returns from a trip a different man from when he left--which greatly disturbs Lisa. She calls the FBI and uncovers a very surprising plot.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
episodes.description: The scariest Simpsons Halloween show yet, featuring an opening by Guillermo Del Toro. Also a malicious behatted creature invades the Simpson home, Bart's head finds a new pair of shoulders and Homer and Marge join a circus full of freaks.

episodes.title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
episodes.description: At the funeral of a man that Springfield loved but we've never met, Marge regrets the music she listened to while pregnant, Brockman regrets a lost opportunity, Burns a lost love and Homer selling his Apple stock.

episodes.title: YOLO
episodes.description: Homer is stunned to learn he'll only live once. A pen pal from his youth helps him live that life to its fullest. Meanwhile Springfield Elementary institutes an honor code.

episodes.title: Labor Pains
episodes.description: Homer helps deliver a baby in an elevator and grows close to the child. Meanwhile, Lisa helps some professional cheerleaders in their battle for better working conditions.

episodes.title: The Kid Is All Right
episodes.description: Lisa makes a new best friend--who turns out to be as conservative as Lisa is liberal. When they run against each other for 2nd grade rep, the Springfield Republican Party tries to tip the scales.

episodes.title: Yellow Subterfuge
episodes.description: When Bart is denied a field trip on a navy sub, Homer plots revenge on Skinner. Meanwhile, Krusty raises money by selling his franchise to foreign clowns.

episodes.title: White Christmas Blues
episodes.description: When Springfield is the only place in America with snow at Christmas, tourists flock to the town and Marge turns the Simpson home into a bed and breakfast. Meanwhile, Lisa decides to go a different way with her annual holiday gifts.

episodes.title: Steal This Episode
episodes.description: Homer becomes annoyed with movie theaters, so Bart teaches him how to download movies illegally. Homer is delighted with his discovery of free movies until he's caught for piracy.

episodes.title: Married to the Blob
episodes.description: Comic Book Guy realizes his comics are nothing if he can't share them with anyone. Then he meets Kumiko, a Japanese woman writing an autobiographical manga, and he seeks out Homer's advice on how to date her, ending happily for everyone.

episodes.title: Specs and the City
episodes.description: Burns gives out "smart glasses" that enable him to spy on his employees. Bart must come up the perfect Valentine for Neslon the bully.

episodes.title: The Man Who Grew Too Much
episodes.description: Lisa campaigns against genetically modified organisms. Meanwhile, Marge teaches abstinence counseling to church teens.

episodes.title: Diggs
episodes.description: Bart befriends a boy and his falcon, then learns the relationship with each is more complicated than he thought.

episodes.title: The Winter of His Content
episodes.description: Marge invites Grampa and two other octogenarians to live at the Simpsons' house after the Retirement Castle is closed for health violations, but she quickly becomes frustrated with Homer when he starts embracing the "old person lifestyle." Meanwhile, at Springfield Elementary, Bart defends Nelson's affinity for hand-me-down underwear, leading Nelson to befriend Bart.

episodes.title: The War of Art
episodes.description: After Lisa's new pet guinea pig destroys the Simpsons' living room art, Marge falls in love with a beautiful painting at the Van Houten's yard sale, which Homer snaps up for 20 bucks. But, when Lisa reveals it's by a famous early 20th century painter and could be worth $100,000, Marge and Homer face a dilemma: split the money with the Van Houtens, or keep the cash as a "cushion" for their kids.

episodes.title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
episodes.description: Lisa declares Homer her hero, but he must prove himself while refereeing at the World Cup. The Simpsons must return to Brazil, the country that hates them most.

episodes.title: Luca$
episodes.description: Lisa meets a boy who dreams of becoming a competitive eater. Meanwhile, Homer gets stuck in a playground slide.

episodes.title: Days of Future Future
episodes.description: 30 years in the future Lisa is married to a zombie and Homer is just a face on a screen. Bart is willing to rewire his brain to forget his ex-wife.

episodes.title: What to Expect When Bart's Expecting
episodes.description: When Bart puts a voodoo curse on a teacher, she gets pregnant and childless couples turn to him for help. Then Fat Tony "asks" him to breed a champion thoroughbred.

episodes.title: Brick Like Me
episodes.description: In the Simpsons' 550th episode, Homer enters a blocky world of dreams. Will he ever again become his normal 2D self?

episodes.title: Pay Pal
episodes.description: Marge wants couples friends, but Homer destroys their chances. She decides to focus on helping Lisa make friends.

episodes.title: Yellow Badge of Cowardge
episodes.description: At field day, Bart undergoes a test of courage that he fails miserably. And when the town cancels fireworks on the Fourth of July, Homer tries to fill the gap.

episodes.title: Clown in the Dumps
episodes.description: A death in Springfield has serious repercussions.

episodes.title: The Wreck of the Relationship
episodes.description: Bart and Homer stage a titanic struggle over a piece of broccoli. They try to repair their relationship on a father/son cruise.

episodes.title: Super Franchise Me
episodes.description: Marge manages a fast-food sandwich franchise but runs into disaster when the chain lets the Spucklers open an outlet across the street.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXV
episodes.description: In the annual Halloween trilogy, Bart goes to school in Hell, and loves it, Moe is a sad old hoodlum in A Clockwork Yellow and the house is haunted by the Tracey Ullman Show Simpsons of days long past.

episodes.title: Opposites-A-Frack
episodes.description: When fire bursts through the Simpsons' water supply, they discover Mr. Burns has been extracting shale oil from the ground below. To politically support his actions, Burns woos a liberal congresswoman.

episodes.title: Simpsorama
episodes.description: The long-awaited Simpsons/Futurama crossover. The Planet Express crew travels back in time to discover, and kill, the present-day Simpson who has ruined the future.

episodes.title: Blazed and Confused
episodes.description: Bart gets a psychotic new teacher. The Simpsons find themselves trapped at a poor man's Burning Man.

episodes.title: Covercraft
episodes.description: Homer forms a cover band with other dads in the neighborhood. Then frontman Apu is poached.

episodes.title: I Won't Be Home For Christmas
episodes.description: A needy Moe keeps Homer late at the bar on Christmas Eve and Marge won't let him come home. Homer embarks on a Christmas Eve odyssey of Springfield's lonely denizens.

episodes.title: The Man Who Came To Be Dinner
episodes.description: The Simpsons visit the home planet of aliens Kang and Kodos. Homer must make the ultimate sacrifice to save his family.

episodes.title: Bart's New Friend
episodes.description: Homer regresses to the mind of a ten year old and becomes Bart's best friend. Bart learns that his father is sweeter and cooler than he ever knew.

episodes.title: The Musk Who Fell to Earth
episodes.description: Tesla founder Elon Musk lands in Springfield and magically transforms the town into a dystopia. His business partner, Mr. Burns, is ruined and seeks revenge.

episodes.title: Walking Big and Tall
episodes.description: A group of wide priders teach Homer it's okay to be plus sized. Meanwhile, Lisa and Bart write a new anthem for Springfield.

episodes.title: My Fare Lady
episodes.description: Marge starts driving for pay but runs afoul of Springfield's cabbies. Meanwhile, Moe's Tavern is destroyed on Ladies' Night.

episodes.title: The Princess Guide
episodes.description: Moe befriends a Nigerian princess whose father has come to make a uranium deal with Mr. Burns. Meanwhile Smithers hopes to retire with Burns to a South Sea Island.

episodes.title: Sky Police
episodes.description: Chief Wiggum accidentally gets a jet pack. Meanwhile, the First Church of Springfield turns to card counting to make money.

episodes.title: Waiting for Duffman
episodes.description: When Springfield's resident Duffman is forced to retire, Homer is thrilled to get the job. Amazingly he doesn't keep it!

episodes.title: Peeping Mom
episodes.description: When Marge suspects Bart isn't being honest with her, she becomes a relentless mother. Meanwhile Flanders gets a new dog that loves Homer.

episodes.title: The Kids Are All Fight
episodes.description: Four-year-old Bart and two-year-old Lisa can't stop fighting, much to their parents' dismay. Featuring the return of Grandma Flanders and Bart's clown bed!

episodes.title: Let's Go Fly A Coot
episodes.description: Members of Grampa's World War II unit attempt to teach Homer respect for his father. Meanwhile Bart gets addicted to kid-friendly e-cigarettes.

episodes.title: Bull-E
episodes.description: Marge's attempt to ban bullying lands half the town in jail. Homer must address the way he has treated Ned Flanders.

episodes.title: Mathlete's Feat
episodes.description: Springfield Elementary loses its electronic devices and becomes a Waldorf school. Willie becomes math team coach and the meet-clinching puzzle has a surprising solution.

episodes.title: Every Man's Dream
episodes.description: Homer is diagnosed with narcolepsy, but instead of returning home with his prescription medication, he returns home drunk. He and Marge visit a marriage counselor and have a trial separation, during which Homer begins dating a 20-something.

episodes.title: Cue Detective
episodes.description: Scotty Boom, a Chew Network super-chef, challenges Homer to a smoke-off. But when someone steals Homer's secret weapon -- a smoker he bought off a mysterious man at a BBQ shack -- Lisa and Bart are on the case.

episodes.title: Puffless
episodes.description: Marge's sisters vow to quit smoking but one quickly succumbs. Maggie befriends the animals on the roof and must save an opossum from Cletus' kitchen.

episodes.title: Halloween of Horror
episodes.description: In this "real" Halloween episode the Simpsons go to a terrifying theme park. Lisa becomes afraid of Halloween and then home invaders attack the Simpson house.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXVI
episodes.description: In the annual fright fest Halloween episode, Sideshow Bob finally kills Bart, only to reanimate him; Homer wakes up with short-term memory loss; and Lisa, Bart, and Milhouse get super powers from radiation.
