episodes.title: Friend with Benefit
episodes.description: Lisa befriends Harper, a new kid at school who happens to be super-rich. Then, Homer befriends Harper's dad and is able to enjoy the perks of Lisa having a rich friend, as well. But Lisa decides that Harper is a bully and moves to end the friendship, which prompts Homer to try and smooth things over so he can continue to enjoy the good life.

episodes.title: Lisa with an 'S'
episodes.description: When Homer loses $5,000 at a poker game with Broadway legend Laney Fontaine, the only way he is able to settle the bet is if he loans Lisa to Laney for a month. Then, Laney turns Lisa into a show biz kid and Marge and Homer fear they made a mistake letting her go. So they head to New York to get her back.

episodes.title: Paths of Glory
episodes.description: Lisa tries to restore the tarnished reputation of Springfield's first female inventor. To find her invention, she scours an abandoned asylum and a restaurant. Bart joins Lisa at the asylum, stealing a homicidal patient's notebook, and brags at school that he wrote the entries himself. This revelation causes Homer and Marge to believe he is a sociopath, which Bart decides to use to his advantage.

episodes.title: Barthood
episodes.description: Bart's coming of age story a la "Boyhood" chronicles his life from six years old to his time as an accomplished young man. Along the way, his tense relationship with Homer, an overly uncaring version of himself, and Lisa, who overshadows him in every way possible, shape Bart more than he realizes.

episodes.title: The Girl Code
episodes.description: Lisa creates artificial intelligence when she designs her own app. Meanwhile Homer realizes he was happiest in life working as a dishwasher in a Greek diner.

episodes.title: Teenage Mutant Milk-Caused Hurdles
episodes.description: Bart grows a starter mustache and gets a crush on his new teacher. Then he discovers Principal Skinner is in love with her too.

episodes.title: Much Apu About Something
episodes.description: Sanjay passes his stake in the Kwik-E-Mart to his millennial son, Jay, who turns it into a hip, health food market against Apu's insistence on tradition. Bart, whom Homer had convinced to give up pranking, is called upon to return to his trickster life and take down the new store.

episodes.title: Love Is in the N2-O2-Ar-CO2-Ne-He-CH4
episodes.description: On Valentine's Day, Professor Frink attempts to uncover the secret to women; Marge worries about the seniors at Grampa's nursing home when she realizes they only experience love while under the influence of medication.

episodes.title: Gal of Constant Sorrow
episodes.description: After Bart accidentally sends a homeless woman's cart into the river, he allows her to live in his closet for a fee. When Lisa discovers the woman is an incredible folk singer, she offers her own closet and plans a concert, only to be disappointed by Hettie's substance abuse and violent nature. Meanwhile Homer tries to prove he's handy, but accidentally traps the cat in the walls of the house.

episodes.title: Lisa the Veterinarian
episodes.description: After performing CPR on a tased raccoon, Lisa discovers her calling to be veterinarian and becomes an intern at the local office, but learns a tough lesson when her neglected class hamster dies. Meanwhile, Marge moonlights as a crime scene cleaner for a little extra money, and the trauma of the gory scenes make her increasingly dead inside.

episodes.title: The Marge-ian Chronicles
episodes.description: Not feeling unique, Lisa signs up for the Mars One Space Colony -- to Marge's dismay. Then, Marge hires Bart to go through the tryout process with Lisa to make her want to quit.

episodes.title: The Burns Cage
episodes.description: When Smithers is devastated by Burns' lack of affection towards him, Homer makes it his mission to find him a boyfriend. Meanwhile, after Bart orchestrates the removal of the lead in the school's stage production of "Casablanca," Milhouse serves as a terrible understudy, which frustrates his co-star, Lisa.

episodes.title: How Lisa Got Her Marge Back
episodes.description: After getting into an argument, Marge takes Lisa on a touristy trip to Capital City, where, after attending a musical, they meet the show's star, Andrew Rannells, who reminds Lisa how lucky she is to have such a great mom. Meanwhile, Bart is frustrated that everyone expects his pranks, so he teams up with Maggie to trick people.

episodes.title: Fland Canyon
episodes.description: Homer recalls a tense family vacation to the Grand Canyon with the Flanders family. At first, the Flanders' perfection puts the families at odds, but when they get stranded and Ned and Bart go for help, the families finally bond.

episodes.title: To Courier with Love
episodes.description: After promising Marge the trip of a lifetime, frugality gets the better of Homer when he makes a deal with a travel agent to be a courier of a top-secret briefcase in exchange for a discounted family vacation to Paris.

episodes.title: Simprovised
episodes.description: After butchering a speech in front of his friends at work, Homer turns to improv comedy to gain back his confidence in his public speaking skills. Meanwhile, Marge decides to rebuild Bart's lackluster treehouse, but tensions rise when Bart questions her building skills.

episodes.title: Orange Is the New Yellow
episodes.description: When Marge gets arrested for letting Bart go to the park unsupervised, she serves time only to realize that prison is a welcome break from the demands of her life as a mom and wife. In her absence, Homer struggles to manage all of the parenting responsibilities that Marge usually handles.

episodes.title: Monty Burns' Fleeing Circus
episodes.description: When Springfield is burned to the ground, the Simpsons beg Mr. Burns to fund its rebuilding. Burns agrees -- with one condition: he gets to put on a variety show at the Springfield Bowl.

episodes.title: Friends and Family
episodes.description: Mr. Burns hires the Simpsons to play his live-in virtual reality family, but excludes Homer so that he may play dad. Now alone, Homer finds a new best friend in girl-next-door Julia, who eats, drinks and thinks like him.

episodes.title: The Town
episodes.description: After Homer catches Bart rooting for Springfield's football rival, the Boston Americans, he plans a family "hate-cation" trip to Boston in an attempt to show Bart that Boston is a terrible city.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXVII
episodes.description: In the midst of a major drought, Mr. Burns introduces a Hunger Games-style contest in which Springfield's children fight each other for a day in Burns' personal reservoir. Meanwhile, Lisa's imaginary best friend, Rachel, is jealous of Lisa's real best friends and starts killing them. Moe tells Bart that the barflies are actually covert agents and that Bart should join their team in Homer's place.

episodes.title: Trust but Clarify
episodes.description: Kent Brockman is fired for stretching the truth. Meanwhile Bart and Lisa investigate Krusty's suspicious new snack.

episodes.title: There Will Be Buds
episodes.description: Kirk and Homer coach lacrosse. This leads to a falling out where Homer must find a sad, lonely Kirk.

episodes.title: Havana Wild Weekend
episodes.description: The Simpsons look to Cuba for better medical care for Grampa. He is rejuvenated by riding the perfectly preserved 1950s cars in Havana.

episodes.title: Dad Behavior
episodes.description: Homer finds an app that does all his chores for him. Having outsourced his fatherly duties, he finds he is losing Bart from his life.

episodes.title: The Last Traction Hero
episodes.description: Homer's injuries leave Marge lonely for companionship.

episodes.title: The Nightmare After Krustmas
episodes.description: Krusty tries to impress his daughter as they spend Christmas with the Simpsons. Meanwhile, Reverend Lovejoy seeks converts after church attendance plummets, and Maggie is haunted by a spooky Christmas toy.

episodes.title: Pork and Burns
episodes.description: Marge adopts a Japanese system for tidiness. Homer gets a service animal also known as...the amazing spider pig.

episodes.title: Fatzcarraldo
episodes.description: Homer rediscovers a chili dog joint he loved as a kid. When it closes he takes it on a quixotic freeway chase through Springfield.

episodes.title: The Cad and the Hat
episodes.description: Lisa gets a new hat that boosts her self confidence. So Bart makes the hat disappear. Meanwhile Homer discusses chess with world champion Magnus Carlsen.

episodes.title: Kamp Krustier
episodes.description: The Simpsons return to Kamp Krusty to cure the children's trauma. Homer discovers abstinence makes him incredibly productive.

episodes.title: 22 for 30
episodes.description: Bart becomes involved in a point shaving scandal in a parody of the "30 for 30" films. Only intervention from an unexpected source can save him.

episodes.title: A Father's Watch
episodes.description: Homer opens a trophy store to cater to overpraised kids. Meanwhile Bart gets a treasured watch from Grampa.

episodes.title: The Caper Chase
episodes.description: Frustrated by efforts to start a nuclear training program at Yale, Mr. Burns starts his own university. Homer becomes a star teacher and goes to work for a mysterious billionaire.

episodes.title: Looking for Mr. Goodbart
episodes.description: Bart befriends generous elderly ladies while Lisa and Homer get caught up in a Pokémon Go style game. Then one of Bart's elderly friends goes missing and he needs Lisa to help find her.

episodes.title: Moho House
episodes.description: Moe is bankrolled to open a swanky private club. It clarifies once and for all his relationship with Homer and Midge, er Marge.

episodes.title: Dogtown
episodes.description: Homer must choose between his dog and ol' Gil. Of course he chooses his dog, and his act inspires Springfield to become the dog-friendliest town in America.

episodes.title: The Great Phatsby Parts 1 & 2
episodes.description: In this hour-long hip hop tribute to the Great Gatsby Burns loses his money to a rap billionaire and seeks his revenge. Meanwhile Smithers heads deep into the Canadian wilderness in search of ice.

episodes.title: The Serfsons
episodes.description: In a world of fantasy the peasant Simpson family struggles with Marge's mother's illness. Meanwhile Lisa's magic powers lead to her capture.

episodes.title: Springfield Splendor
episodes.description: Lisa and Marge team up on a graphic novel which becomes a musical. Marge receives all the credit and Lisa is humiliated.

episodes.title: Whistler's Father
episodes.description: Maggie reveals a hidden talent and Grampa tries to exploit it. Marge gets a job as a decorator for the mob.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXVIII
episodes.description: The Simpsons become Halloween candy; Maggie requires an exorcism; Lisa gets a better life if buttons are sewn on her eyes and Homer discovers the most delicious food of all.

episodes.title: Grampy Can Ya Hear Me
episodes.description: Grampa gets a hearing aid which tells him more about the world than he wants to know. Skinner learns that his mother shattered his boyhood dream.

episodes.title: The Old Blue Mayor She Ain't What She Used to Be
episodes.description: After the ancient Springfield monorail runs amok, Marge becomes mayor and vows to put out the long-burning tire fire.

episodes.title: Singin' in the Lane
episodes.description: Homer's bowling team reunites. Their friendship is tested with Moe, their coach.

episodes.title: Mr. Lisa's Opus
episodes.description: A look at Lisa's life from talking toddler to college-bound. Plus Homer enters a 12-step plan.

episodes.title: Gone Boy
episodes.description: Bart disappears and the whole town can't find him. Then he is located by a vengeful Sideshow Bob.

episodes.title: Haw-Haw Land
episodes.description: Lisa meets a jazz-addicted boy and must choose between him and Nelson. Meanwhile, Bart takes up chemistry, but to what end?

episodes.title: Fink Gets Testy
episodes.description: Burns fears the end of the world and builds a cosmic ark. When he tests the town for worthiness, Marge is dismayed when Bart comes out on the bottom.

episodes.title: Homer Is Where the Art Isn't
episodes.description: Homer learns to love a piece of art. Then it's stolen and he's blamed.

episodes.title: 3 Scenes Plus a Tag from a Marriage
episodes.description: The Simpsons visit their old apartment and remember the days without their kids. And we learn a surprising secret from Lisa's birth.

episodes.title: Fears of a Clown
episodes.description: Due to a general fear of clowns, Krusty can no longer do his job. He tries to get work as a serious actor. Meanwhile Bart undergoes therapy for serial pranking.

episodes.title: No Good Read Goes Unpunished
episodes.description: Bart tries to conquer Homer with help from a book. Marge discovers a childhood classic she loved does not translate well to these times.

episodes.title: King Leer
episodes.description: Moe inherits a mattress business from his father, then lands in an all-out war with his siblings.

episodes.title: Lisa Gets the Blues
episodes.description: Lisa gets the yips and Bart gets Annie'd. They go to New Orleans to recover.

episodes.title: Forgive and Regret
episodes.description: Grampa is about to die when he reveals a terrible secret. Homer struggles with how to forgive him.

episodes.title: Left Behind
episodes.description: Flanders loses his job and works with Homer at the plant. Homer prays for him to be fired.

episodes.title: Throw Grampa from the Dane
episodes.description: The Simpsons visit Denmark and everyone but Homer falls in love with the happy country. Meanwhile Grampa needs a serious operation.

episodes.title: Flanders' Ladder
episodes.description: Bart is struck by lightning and has horrible dreams. Maude Flanders returns to seek her revenge.

episodes.title: Bart's Not Dead
episodes.description: Bart takes a dare that lands him in a coma. To get out of trouble, he pretends he went to heaven and saw Jesus. It becomes a Christian movie, and Bart is wracked with guilt.

episodes.title: Heartbreak Hotel
episodes.description: Homer and Marge go on an amazing race type show where they are eliminated immediately. They are confined to the nearby motel, which they enjoy until Marge learned Homer screwed up.

episodes.title: My Way or the Highway to Heaven
episodes.description: The Simpsons explore three ways to get into heaven. They include Ned Flanders' conversion as a young trampoline salesman, Marge's atheist grandmother in World War II, and Siddhartha.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXIX
episodes.description: In this annual terror-themed trilogy, the Simpsons battle spores from space, Homer has an eating contest with the monster C'thulhu, Lisa experiences multiple, murderous personalities, and Grampa is put into a Jurassic Park-style senior home.

episodes.title: Baby You Can't Drive My Car
episodes.description: Marge and Homer work together at a cool tech company that makes self-driving cars. They discover the cars have a sinister hidden app.

episodes.title: From Russia Without Love
episodes.description: Bart orders a Russian bride for Moe. She turns Moe's life around, and he falls in love.

episodes.title: Werking Mom
episodes.description: Marge becomes a successful Tupperware saleswoman because customers think she's a man in drag. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to do secret good deeds for people.

episodes.title: Krusty the Clown
episodes.description: Homer becomes an internet recapper while Krusty joins the circus.

episodes.title: Daddicus Finch
episodes.description: Lisa reads "To Kill a Mockingbird" and begins to observe wonderful similarities between her dad and Atticus Finch. Meanwhile Bart discovers what a Bat Mitzvah is and pranks one.

episodes.title: 'Tis the 30th Season
episodes.description: After a terrible Black Friday where Marge can't get the gift the kids desperately want, the Simpsons try to spend a relaxing Florida Christmas.

episodes.title: Mad About the Toy
episodes.description: Grampa learns a startling secret from his past. It takes him to Texas to find a long-lost life.

episodes.title: The Girl on the Bus
episodes.description: Lisa discovers the ideal family... and lies about her own.

episodes.title: I'm Dancing as Fat as I Can
episodes.description: When Homer breaks a promise and binge watches a show without Marge, she is more furious than she's ever been. He secretly studies ballroom dancing to try to win her back.

episodes.title: The Clown Stays in the Picture
episodes.description: In a podcast Krusty discusses a lost film he made in the '80s. Homer and Marge worked on it and Krusty tries to drive them apart.

episodes.title: 101 Mitigations
episodes.description: Homer goes on a joyride and is threatened with prison by Comic Book Guy. The family makes a mitigation video to shorten his sentence.

episodes.title: I Want You (She's So Heavy)
episodes.description: Homer gets an inguinal hernia which comes to life. Meanwhile, Marge rehabs from an injury with kite surfing.

episodes.title: E My Sports
episodes.description: Bart earns money in a video game competition. Homer becomes coach, and the team makes the finals in South Korea.

episodes.title: Bart vs. Itchy and Scratchy
episodes.description: Bart is upset to learn there is a new, all-girl version of Itchy and Scratchy.

episodes.title: Girl's in the Band
episodes.description: Lisa joins an advanced youth orchestra in Capital City, throwing the family's lives into havoc. Homer works the night shift and nearly goes mad.

episodes.title: I'm Just a Girl Who Can't Say D'oh
episodes.description: Marge becomes director of a local theater production. She battles indefatigably when it grows into a live show in a thunderstorm.

episodes.title: D'oh Canada
episodes.description: Lisa goes to Canada and refuses to leave. A desperate Marge tries to get her back.

episodes.title: Woo-Hoo Dunnit?
episodes.description: A $600 theft rocks the Simpson home. A local TV crime show attempts to crack it to no avail.

episodes.title: Crystal Blue-Haired Persuasion
episodes.description: Marge sells crystals and makes a fortune. Meanwhile Bart's grades take a mysterious turn for the better.

episodes.title: The Winter of Our Monetized Content
episodes.description: Homer and Bart become viral sensations. Meanwhile, Lisa is sent to detention and is forced to make license plates.

episodes.title: Go Big or Go Homer
episodes.description: Feeling disrespected, Homer becomes a mentor to an unstable middle-aged intern who idolizes him. But Homer makes a terrible mistake -- giving his mentee the confidence to follow his dreams.

episodes.title: The Fat Blue Line
episodes.description: Fat Tony is framed, and Wiggum must exonerate him. Homer uses his butt as a pickpocketing decoy.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXX
episodes.description: This 666th episode of the Simpsons parodies spooky favorites, including The Omen, not to mention a little Crazy Rich Aliens.

episodes.title: Gorillas on the Mast
episodes.description: Homer buys a boat and is dismayed to learn the cost of operation. Lisa frees a whale, so Bart frees a gorilla.

episodes.title: Marge the Lumberjill
episodes.description: Marge worries that her life is boring, so she takes up timbersports and moves to Oregon, birthplace of Matt Groening.

episodes.title: Livin' la Pura Vida
episodes.description: Marge's dream multi-family vacation to Costa Rica is ruined when Homer discovers he actually gets along with Patty's new girlfriend.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving of Horror
episodes.description: Three tales of Thanksgiving terror: a bloody first "turkey day," a virtual Marge cooks for survival against real Marge, and a space mission is threatened by a murderous side dish.

episodes.title: Todd, Todd, Why Hast Thou Forsaken Me?
episodes.description: Todd loses his faith in God. Homer and Ned share a near-death experience.

episodes.title: Bobby, It's Cold Outside
episodes.description: Sideshow Bob returns, and Christmas is threatened. Bart tries to make sense of it all.

episodes.title: Hail to the Teeth
episodes.description: Marge's old suitor, Artie Ziff, returns, and he's engaged. Meanwhile, a man tells Lisa she'd be more popular if she smiled more, and against her wishes, she does.

episodes.title: The Miseducation of Lisa Simpson
episodes.description: Springfield steals the Sea Captain's treasure to build a S.T.E.M. academy, but Lisa and Bart discover that the school has terrifying hidden plans. Homer tries to prove he's better at pouring soda than a soda-pouring machine.

episodes.title: Frinkcoin
episodes.description: Professor Frink develops a crypto currency that makes him rich. Then he wonders if his new friends are true friends.

episodes.title: Bart the Bad Guy
episodes.description: When Bart sees the superhero movie of the summer before anyone else, he uses his "spoiler powers" to blackmail the town... but will it cost him his soul?

episodes.title: Screenless
episodes.description: The family goes without electronic devices. One member surprisingly cracks and heads to rehab.

episodes.title: Better Off Ned
episodes.description: After a prank, Ned mentors Bart, and his life greatly improves. A jealous Homer becomes a mentor to Nelson.

episodes.title: Highway to Well
episodes.description: Marge discovers she has a talent for healing when she works at a cannabis dispensary. Homer discovers he has a talent for dealing when he opens a rival dispensary at Moe's.

episodes.title: The Incredible Lightness of Being a Baby
episodes.description: Cletus becomes a helium tycoon. Maggie reunites with baby Hudson from Playdate with Destiny.

episodes.title: Warrin' Priests
episodes.description: Pete Holmes guest stars as a charismatic new preacher. Lovejoy investigates his mysterious past.

episodes.title: Warrin' Priests Part Two
episodes.description: Reverend Lovejoy uncovers the truth about the popular, new preacher. Lisa is shattered.

episodes.title: The Hateful Eight-Year-Olds
episodes.description: Lisa is tormented by spoiled influencer girls at the sleepover from hell. Homer makes plans and takes Marge on a sunset cruise. (Musical Guests: Weezer)

episodes.title: The Way of the Dog
episodes.description: After the Simpsons' dog bites Marge, the family explores the tragic past of Santa's Little Helper.

episodes.title: Undercover Burns
episodes.description: Mr. Burns goes undercover to see what the employees really think of him. He becomes their friends and to Smithers' alarm.

episodes.title: I, Carumbus
episodes.description: The Simpson family goes to Ancient Rome. Homer is a gladiator, and Bart becomes madder than Caligula.

episodes.title: Now Museum, Now You Don't
episodes.description: Lisa stays home from school to explore the wonders of western art. We see her as Lisanardo, Bart as a French impressionist, Homer and Marge as Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo, and Maggie as a warrior Cupid.

episodes.title: Treehouse Of Horror XXXI
episodes.description: The annual Simpsons terror-themed trilogy, including a frightening look at the 2020 election, parodies of Pixar and Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, and a 9th birthday Lisa just can't get over.

episodes.title: The 7 Beer Itch
episodes.description: When Marge and the kids take a seaside vacation, Homer is unwittingly tempted by a British femme fatale. Then Mr. Burns makes Homer his romantic go-between with extremely unintended consequences.

episodes.title: Podcast News
episodes.description: Grampa is accused of a crime in this return to the Simpsons. Meanwhile Kent Brockman questions his career.

episodes.title: Three Dreams Denied
episodes.description: Bart becomes a voiceover actor and Comic Book Guy is humiliated at Comic-Con. Meanwhile, Lisa is set up for a fall.

episodes.title: The Road To Cincinnati
episodes.description: Odd couple Skinner and Chalmers embark on an 800-mile car ride to Cincinnati to attend an administrator's convention. But whether they reach their destination without killing each other first is anyone's guess.

episodes.title: Sorry Not Sorry
episodes.description: Lisa calls her teacher a hack and refuses to apologize. Then she learns Ms. Hoover's private pain.

episodes.title: A Springfield Summer Christmas for Christmas
episodes.description: A cable channel films a Christmas movie in Springfield and Skinner falls in love.

episodes.title: The Dad-Feelings Limited
episodes.description: Comic book guy and his wife Kumiko debate having a baby. We learn his awesome origin story.

episodes.title: Diary Queen
episodes.description: Bart finds his old teacher's diary and learns a surprising secret. It changes his life, and then Lisa discovers an even bigger surprise.

episodes.title: Wad Goals
episodes.description: Bart becomes a successful caddy but Marge worries it is ruining his character.

episodes.title: Yokel Hero
episodes.description: Cletus becomes a singing sensation, while Homer becomes a new man. Then, Cletus turns on his fans, ruining everything.

episodes.title: Do Pizza Bots Dream Of Electric Guitars
episodes.description: Homer tries to reunite a mechanical band from his youth, but film and TV creator J.J. Abrams gets ahold of them first.

episodes.title: Manger Things
episodes.description: We learn a secret of Flanders' past and discover a room in the Simpson home we've never seen.

episodes.title: Uncut Femmes
episodes.description: We learn that Chief Wiggum's wife is more than she seems. Marge takes part in a jewel heist.

episodes.title: Burger Kings
episodes.description: Mr. Burns gets into the plant-based burger business. Lisa refuses to believe he's up to no good.

episodes.title: Panic on the Streets of Springfield
episodes.description: Lisa gets an imaginary friend who makes her feel much better about her friend. Homer gets a vehicle with awesome torque.

episodes.title: Mother and Child Reunion
episodes.description: Lisa makes a shocking college decision, wounding Marge. It leads to a very surprising place.

episodes.title: The Man From G.R.A.M.P.A.
episodes.description: A British secret agent comes to Springfield in search of a Russian spy.

episodes.title: The Last Barfighter
episodes.description: After Moe breaks their most sacred rule, a secret society of bartenders seeks ultimate vengeance on Homer and his friends.

episodes.title: The Star of the Backstage
episodes.description: A musical comes to life in Springfield as Marge stages a revival of her beloved high school show--but her wonderful memories are threatened by the return of a rival from the past.

episodes.title: Bart's In Jail
episodes.description: When Grampa falls victim to a phone scammer, the Simpsons set out on a mission of vengeance to get his money back.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXII
episodes.description: Bong Joon-ho's "Parasite," Bambi's revenge and much, much more.

episodes.title: The Wayz We Were
episodes.description: Evergreen Terrace is overrun with traffic and Moe has a fateful choice to make.

episodes.title: Lisa's Belly
episodes.description: Marge puts a hurtful word in Lisa's brain and Bart gets swole.

episodes.title: A Serious Flanders (Part I and Part II)
episodes.description: When a ruthless debt collector comes to Springfield, Homer and Ned's lives are sucked into the artfully violent world of prestige TV. Things for Ned and Homer go from bad to gosh-darn worse in the stunning conclusion of this SIMPFLIX prestige crime thriller.

episodes.title: Portrait of a Lackey On Fire
episodes.description: Smithers finds true love with a famous fashion designer (voiced by Victor Garber), but will his new relationship destroy Springfield?

episodes.title: Mothers And Other Strangers
episodes.description: Teenage Homer and Grampa go on a road trip to ease their sorrow.

episodes.title: A Made Maggie
episodes.description: Fat Tony becomes Godfather to Maggie Simpson.

episodes.title: The Longest Marge
episodes.description: Marge and Mr. Burns fight for soul of a brash young football prodigy.

episodes.title: Pixelated & Afraid
episodes.description: When Homer and Marge are lost in an icy wilderness, they must push themselves to their limits to survive.

episodes.title: Boyz N the Highlands
episodes.description: Bart, Martin and the bullies are on the run for their lives when a wilderness weekend takes a chilling turn.

episodes.title: You Won't Believe What This Episode is About - Act Three Will Shock You!
episodes.description: When Homer is erroneously blamed for leaving Santa's Little Helper locked in a hot car, footage of the incident goes viral, outraging all of Springfield and making Homer a pariah.

episodes.title: Bart the Cool Kid
episodes.description: When Bart befriends a famous kid influencer who owns an ultra-cool skate wear brand, Homer leads a rebellion of loser dads against them.

episodes.title: Pretty Whittle Liar
episodes.description: Cletus discovers that his wife Brandine has been hiding a secret love....of learning.

episodes.title: The Sound of Bleeding Gums
episodes.description: Lisa meets the son of the late musician Bleeding Gums Murphy--and attempts to improve his life.

episodes.title: My Octopus and a Teacher
episodes.description: Bart can't control his feelings when he gets a new teacher. Meanwhile, Lisa befriends an octopus.

episodes.title: Girls Just Shauna Have Fun
episodes.description: When Lisa joins the high school marching band, she finds an unlikely mentor in Shauna Chalmers. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a craft beer brewer.

episodes.title: Marge the Meanie
episodes.description: A surprise from Marge's past has her bonding with Bart and terrifying Homer.

episodes.title: Meat is Murder
episodes.description: Grampa finds himself in a pickle when his hidden hamburger past comes back to "ketchup" with him.

episodes.title: Poorhouse Rock
episodes.description: After Bart humiliates him at church, Homer finally teaches his son to admire his dad--until a visit from a magical, singing janitor (Hugh Jackman) changes everything they thought they knew.

episodes.title: Habeas Tortoise
episodes.description: After Homer humiliates himself in a town meeting, he looks for acceptance in an internet group hunting for a missing tortoise but finds something much more sinister.

episodes.title: One Angry Lisa
episodes.description: Lisa gets called for jury duty while Marge becomes obsessed with her exercise bike.

episodes.title: Lisa the Boy Scout
episodes.description: When the Boy Explorers become co-ed, Bart and Lisa vow to "out scout" each other at the annual jamboree.

episodes.title: The King of Nice
episodes.description: Marge is hired as a segment producer on Krusty's new daytime talk show. But her initial excitement about the job fades when she discovers what an endless nightmare it is.

episodes.title: Not It
episodes.description: In this "Treehouse of Horror" Halloween episode, Homer and his teenaged friends are pursued by a killer clown in a spoof of Stephen King's novel "It".

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXIII
episodes.description: In a book-themed trilogy, Marge's resentment takes monstrous form, Lisa tries to save the planet through murder and Homer learns he's not the man he thought he was.

episodes.title: From Beer to Paternity
episodes.description: When Homer becomes Duffman's girl-dad hero, they go on a road trip with Lisa that threatens to expose Homer's terrible parenting.

episodes.title: Step Brother from the Same Planet
episodes.description: Homer is stunned by his feelings of rage and resentment when Grampa becomes a doting stepfather to his girlfriend's quirky young son. Lisa and Bart throw the ultimate slumber party.

episodes.title: When Nelson Met Lisa
episodes.description: A future tale of the will-they-won't-they-I-guess-they-won't-maybe-they-will of Springfield's most unlikely couple.

episodes.title: Game Done Changed
episodes.description: When Bart discovers a profitable glitch in an online game, he ropes Principal Skinner into his lucrative criminal enterprise. Marge and Maggie discover paradise.

episodes.title: Top Goon
episodes.description: When Coach Moe recruits the world's greatest brawlers to teach Nelson the art of hockey goonery, Simpsons fans are enraged by a second hockey episode in 35 years.

episodes.title: My Life as a Vlog
episodes.description: Through a series of YouTube recommended videos, the story of the rise and fall of The Simpson Family Vlog is revealed.

episodes.title: The Many Saints of Springfield
episodes.description: When Ned Flanders falls on hard times, Fat Tony makes him an offer he can't refuse. But when Flanders realizes he accidentally partnered with the mob, and wants the relationship to end, Fat Tony ominously warns there's only one way for that to happen.

episodes.title: Carl Carlson Rides Again
episodes.description: When Carl is smitten by a beautiful black woman, he looks into the roots of his own identity by discovering the origins of a mysterious rodeo buckle.

episodes.title: Bartless
episodes.description: When Bart's latest prank leads to chaos at Springfield Elementary, Marge and Homer dream of a world in which their rambunctious son was never a Simpson.

episodes.title: Hostile Kirk Place
episodes.description: When Milhouse's Dad, Kirk, takes exception to a school history lesson that paints one of his ancestors in a bad light, Kirk goes on a crusade to censor and control the school curriculum -- a crusade that Homer co-opts for fun and profit.

episodes.title: Pin Gal
episodes.description: A mysterious figure from Marge's past returns to coach her for a bowling tournament.

episodes.title: Fan-ily Feud
episodes.description: Homer publicly disparages a pop singer and faces the ire of her vindictive and highly organized fan army.

episodes.title: Write Off This Episode
episodes.description: When Marge and Lisa start a charity together, Marge is seduced by the money and prestige of Big Charity fundraising.

episodes.title: The Very Hungry Caterpillars
episodes.description: When a plague of insects shuts down Springfield, the Simpsons face their greatest challenge yet...spending time in lockdown with each other.

episodes.title: Clown V. Board of Education
episodes.description: Krusty opens a school for clowning, and it becomes the most successful thing he's ever done.

episodes.title: Homer's Adventures Through the Windshield Glass
episodes.description: Time stands still after Homer crashes his car and flies through the windshield. As his life flashes before his eyes, a magical friend (voiced and sung by Lizzo) helps Homer learn the secret truth about his marriage.

episodes.title: Homer's Crossing
episodes.description: Feeling worthless at work, Homer volunteers to be a school crossing guard. But when his safety squad receives too much funding, the crossing guards become a force to be feared.

episodes.title: A Mid-Childhood Night's Dream
episodes.description: Marge feels an overwhelming dread of the empty nest.

episodes.title: McMansion & Wife
episodes.description: When a new neighbor showers him with kindness, Homer thinks he's being tricked into buying a sports car at the dealership where the neighbor works--but the truth turns out to be even more sinister; Lisa neutralizes Nelson after he goes on a bullying spree.

episodes.title: Thirst Trap: A Corporate Love Story
episodes.description: In a parody documentary, a young college-dropout CEO embraces the Silicon Valley "fake it until you make it" philosophy and bewitches Mr. Burns into funding her highly dubious dream project.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXIV
episodes.description: After Bart is turned into an NFT, Marge fights though the blockchain to rescue her son. To track down a gruesome serial killer, Lisa turns to a murderer from her past. An outbreak transforms Springfielders into a plague of lazy, beer-loving oafs.

episodes.title: Iron Marge
episodes.description: When Marge's heart is broken by a bad birthday present, Bart and Lisa must dig into their mom's past to show that they really know her. Homer becomes a neighborhood fear-monger.

episodes.title: It's a Blunderful Life
episodes.description: Lisa recounts the story of how Homer was scapegoated for a power outage that plunged Springfield into darkness days before Thanksgiving.

episodes.title: Ae Bonny Romance
episodes.description: When Groundskeeper Willie is kidnapped to Scotland, Bart and the Simpsons follow -- only to discover that what awaits is Homer's worst nightmare.

episodes.title: Murder, She Boat
episodes.description: Lisa must solve a closed-boat mystery when Comic Book Guy's million-dollar action figure is "murdered" on a pop culture cruise.

episodes.title: Do the Wrong Thing
episodes.description: Homer and Bart become kings of the blue-collar sports circuit, but Marge suspects something dishonest at the core of their father-son bond.

episodes.title: Frinkenstein's Monster
episodes.description: Professor Frink secretly helps Homer, through a zoom interview, land a high-level position at a state-of-the-art nuclear plant in Shelbyville. But since Homer lacks the skills to actually perform the job, Frink must monitor Homer's work situation remotely and dictate his every word...causing Frink to fear he's created a monster.

episodes.title: Lisa Gets an F1
episodes.description: Lisa feels a need for speed as well a need for control of her anxiety when she becomes a pro kid go-cart racer.

episodes.title: Clan of the Cave Mom
episodes.description: A parenting disagreement between Marge and Luann Van Houten escalates into a life-or-death struggle for survival.

episodes.title: Night of the Living Wage
episodes.description: Marge gets a job in a high-pressure ghost kitchen, but when she tries to start a union, she gets more than she collectively bargained for.

episodes.title: Cremains of the Day
episodes.description: When someone in Homer's life passes away, he and guys from Moe's go on a road trip to scatter the ashes... but will their friendship die as well?

episodes.title: The Tell-Tale Pants
episodes.description: Marge comes upon a surprising windfall and, angry with Homer, spends it secretly on herself.

episodes.title: The Tipping Point
episodes.description: Homer loses his mind over tipping culture run amok.

episodes.title: Bart's Brain
episodes.description: Bart makes a new friend.

episodes.title: Bart's Birthday
episodes.description: Bart celebrates a birthday that will change his life forever.

episodes.title: The Yellow Lotus
episodes.description: The Simpsons encounter death on vacation at a high-end resort.

episodes.title: Desperately Seeking Lisa
episodes.description: Lisa has a blazing misadventure in the dark world of Capital City's downtown art scene.

episodes.title: Shoddy Heat
episodes.description: An unearthed corpse opens up a cold case from Springfield in the 1980s... as well as a steamy relationship between young Grampa and Agnes Skinner.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXV
episodes.description: Giant monsters created by political rage threaten to tear the town apart, a Victorian Mr. Burns is jump-scared on Thanksgiving by the ghosts of his abused workers, and Homer bonds with a pair of extra-terrestrial jeans in an unforgettable stop-motion adventure that can only be called... Denim.

episodes.title: Women in Shorts
episodes.description: Girls just want to have funny.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror Presents: Simpsons Wicked This Way Comes
episodes.description: A tattooed man at a mysterious night circus transports Lisa into three strange stories from the innocent 1950s, the chilling retro-present, and a brutalist future where prestige TV rules the world.

episodes.title: Convenience Airways
episodes.description: The Simpsons are trapped on a flight with the most unruly passengers in America.

episodes.title: Homer and Her Sisters
episodes.description: After a fight in an escape room, Krusty's truth-telling Aunt fixes Homer's relationship with Patty and Selma.

episodes.title: The Man Who Flew Too Much
episodes.description: The new and improved Pin Pals travel to Capital City for their first ever state bowling championship.

episodes.title: Bottle Episode
episodes.description: Marge and Smithers team up to become wine-forging Robin Hoods.

episodes.title: The Flandshees of Innersimpson
episodes.description: Bart dips his toe into the world of celebrity DJ-ing, and Homer finally pushes Flanders too far.

episodes.title: The Last Man Expanding
episodes.description: Springfield becomes hooked on a miracle weight loss drug... all except Homer.

episodes.title: P.S. I Hate You
episodes.description: Marge's "nice-lady" reputation is on the line when an unknown blackmailer threatens to expose the angry woman she is inside.

episodes.title: Abe League of Their Moe
episodes.description: After Grampa and Moe recruit a Macedonian slugger to play in Springfield, it strains their friendship and the very integrity of baseball.

episodes.title: Stew Lies
episodes.description: Homer reinvigorates a celebrity chef's lost passion for food -- with some help from the mob.

episodes.title: Full Heart, Empty Pool
episodes.description: Homer and Grampa team up to create a new sport that rivals pickleball, until Homer kicks Grampa off the team.

episodes.title: Estranger Things
episodes.description: When Bart & Lisa stop watching Itchy & Scratchy together, Marge fears that they'll start to drift apart... but she has no idea how bad things are about to get!

episodes.title: Thrifty Ways to Thieve Your Mother
episodes.description: When Lisa starts wearing Marge's "vintage" clothes from the 90's, she's welcomed into the school's super-elite fashion club. But as they run out of retro looks, the funky fashionistas become obsessed with getting more...by hook or by crook.

episodes.title: Keep Chalm and Gary On
episodes.description: Homer gets Superintendent Chalmers a job at the power plant. There, Chalmers discovers huge, mutated snails that produce valuable slime, launching his new career as a man-o-sphere guru.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXVI
episodes.description: In this year's installment of the annual fright-fest, the town is menaced by a mysterious, murdering monster from out of the sewers; Krusty has a demonic special guest on his live Halloween special; and we go a thousand years into Springfield's poseable plastic, post-apocalyptic future.

episodes.title: Men Behaving Manly
episodes.description: Springfield's men are in crisis.

episodes.title: Bad Boys...For Life?
episodes.description: Is Bart Simpson truly a bad seed? Homer and Marge must find out once and for good.

episodes.title: Bart 'n' Frink
episodes.description: When Bart becomes Professor Frink's lab assistant, the Simpsons are thrown into a world of tech billionaires determined to live forever, with the future of the internet at stake.

episodes.title: Sashes to Sashes
episodes.description: Bart runs against Mayor Quimby's son for student council president, while Lisa learns troubling secrets about the Quimby clan...and about the Simpsons.

episodes.title: The Day of the Jack-up
episodes.description: After a mysterious buyer purchases every ticket for the KPOP concert Lisa wants to go to, the Simpsons have to figure out the identity of this evil ticket reseller. Or do they? (Yes, they do.)

episodes.title: Aunt Misbehavin'
episodes.description: Patty and Bart team up for the ultimate prank: getting Homer declared legally dead. To their chagrin, Homer loves being officially dead -- which leads to Patty and Selma having a huge fight and Patty moving away to "Palm Springfield."

episodes.title: Guess Who's Coming to Skinner
episodes.description: When Principal Skinner discovers that one of his students is a runaway who has been living in the school library, he has to take the snarky, difficult kid into his home and is forced into a role he never expected or wanted -- being a parent.

episodes.title: Parahormonal Activity
episodes.description: Set in the near future, Marge is competently coping with the hormonal onslaught hitting her now teenage kids when she's suddenly struck by a big life change of her own, leaving Homer as the last sane person in the house...or is he?

episodes.title: "The Fall Guy-Yi-Yi!"
episodes.description: Homer revitalizes Bumblebee Man's career when he becomes his secret stuntman. But how much punishment can a Stunt-Bee take before it starts to sting?

episodes.title: Seperance
episodes.description: Homer's enthusiasm skills land him a job at a secretive company with a mind-altering agenda.

episodes.title: Irrational Treasure
episodes.description: Marge's crusade to get the family dog in better shape leads to her entering Santa's Little Helper in canine agility competitions and a trip to the National Dog Show in Philadelphia. There, Marge and Homer suddenly find themselves -- and the dog -- mixed up in a historical conspiracy adventure worthy of a "National Treasure" movie.

episodes.title: Homer? A Cracker Bro?
episodes.description: Homer strikes up an unlikely friendship with Kirk Van Houten, which leads them to launching a hugely successful business venture together -- a "crumbless" cracker that sweeps the nation. But when Kirk's darkest secrets are revealed, Homer has to choose between his family and his fortune...and may just end up going to jail!

episodes.title: The Simpsons Movie
episodes.description: After Homer accidentally pollutes the town's water supply, Springfield is encased in a gigantic dome by the EPA and the Simpsons family are declared fugitives.

episodes.title: The Longest Daycare
episodes.description: In this Oscar-nominated short from The Simpsons, Maggie must navigate an eventful first day at daycare. When Marge drops her off at the Ayn Rand School for Tots, Maggie is diagnosed with average intelligence. Barred from the scholarly gifted children, she longs to escape from her glue-guzzling classmates. But when a lonely caterpillar befriends her, she makes it her mission to save it from a ruthless butterfly-smashing toddler.

episodes.title: Maggie Simpson in Playdate with Destiny
episodes.description: It seemed like just another day at the park for Maggie Simpson. But when Maggie faces playground peril, a heroic young baby whisks her from danger -- and steals her heart. After a blissful first playdate, Maggie can't wait to see her new baby beau again the following day, but things don't go exactly as planned. Will fate (or Homer) get in her way?

episodes.title: Maggie Simpson in The Force Awakens from Its Nap
episodes.description: In a daycare far, far away... but still in Springfield, Maggie is on an epic quest for her stolen pacifier. Her adventure brings her face-to-face with young Padawans, Sith Lords, familiar droids, Rebel scum, and an ultimate battle against the Dark Side, in this original short celebrating the Star Wars galaxy.

episodes.title: The Good, the Bart, and the Loki
episodes.description: Banished from Asgard once again, Loki must face his toughest opponents yet: the Simpsons and Springfield's mightiest heroes. The God of Mischief teams up with Bart Simpson in the ultimate crossover event paying tribute to the Marvel Cinematic Universe of Super Heroes and villains. Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

episodes.title: The Simpsons in Plusaversary
episodes.description: The Simpsons host a Disney+ Day party and everyone is on the list... except Homer. With friends from across the service and music fit for a Disney princess, Plusaversary is Springfield's event of the year.

episodes.title: Te Deseo Lo Mejor
episodes.description: Bad Bunny counsels Homer and Marge in the new music video for his single "Te Deseo Lo Mejor."

episodes.title: When Billie Met Lisa
episodes.description: While searching for a quiet place to practice her saxophone, Lisa Simpson is discovered by GRAMMY® Award-winning and chart-topping artists Billie Eilish and Finneas O'Connell. Billie invites Lisa to her studio for a special jam session she'll never forget.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Club
episodes.description: It's Disney+ Day and Lisa Simpson has her heart set on the ultimate princess transformation. After meeting some of Disney's most notorious villains, Lisa is surprised to learn being bad just might be more fun.

episodes.title: The Simpsons Meet the Bocellis in Feliz Navidad
episodes.description: This Christmas, Homer surprises Marge with the ultimate gift: an unforgettable performance from Italian opera superstar Andrea Bocelli and his children Matteo and Virginia.

episodes.title: Maggie Simpson in Rogue Not Quite One
episodes.description: On their way to daycare, Homer loses track of Maggie who hops in Grogu's hovering pram for a hyperspace-hopping adventure across the galaxy. Facing a squadron of Imperial TIE fighters, Maggie brings the battle to Springfield in this epic short celebrating all things Star Wars.

episodes.title: May the 12th Be With You
episodes.description: It's Mother's Day and Marge Simpson joins the moms of Disney+ on a special holiday outing that turns into an epic galactic adventure filled with heroes, villains, and Stewie from Family Guy.

episodes.title: The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
episodes.description: Sideshow Bob teams up with the most infamous villains of Disney+ to share the true meaning of the Halloween season. Filled with music, mayhem, and madness, this short from "The Simpsons" is simply to die for. Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

episodes.title: O C'mon All Ye Faithful
episodes.description: Celebrate the holidays in Springfield with the first ever Simpsons double-episode, streaming exclusively on Disney+. When famed British mentalist Derren Brown arrives in Springfield for a holiday experiment, things go ho-ho-horribly awry, as Homer gets hypnotized and believes he is Santa Claus. A cheery chain-reaction is set off throughout the town, causing everyone to question what they believe and to explore the meaning of "miracle." Featuring musical performances by Patti LaBelle and Pentatonix, this holiday special event marks the 35th anniversary of The Simpsons original Christmas special, "Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire."

episodes.title: The Past and the Furious
episodes.description: In this Disney+ exclusive episode of The Simpsons, Lisa struggles with Springfield's barren landscape and is transported back in time to 1923. There, she discovers that the Springfield Mini Moose, once a keystone species, were driven to extinction in 1925, leading to the town's environmental collapse. Lisa teams up with a young Monty Burns to protect the moose and restore balance to the ecosystem, but her actions unintentionally help shape Burns into the ruthless tycoon he becomes.

episodes.title: Yellow Planet
episodes.description: In this Disney+ exclusive episode of The Simpsons, the family is reimagined as animals in a nature mockumentary. Narrated in the style of National Geographic, the episode follows Homer and Marge as whales from different species drawn together by instinct, Bart as a newly hatched iguana fighting to survive against relentless predators, and Lisa as a finch leading her flock toward innovation. As each character faces the challenges of the natural world, familiar faces from Springfield appear in unexpected ways, bringing a fresh perspective to the struggle for survival in the wild.

episodes.title: The Simpsons Yule Log
episodes.description: D'oh D'oh D'oh! It's the holiday season in Springfield, so grab a Flaming Moe (egg nog) and cozy up in front of a fake fireplace with your favorite TV family. Mmm... holiday nostalgia.

episodes.title: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition
episodes.description: In this Disney+ exclusive double-episode, Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer. The special guest stars Betty Gilpin, with musical guests Laufey, and Tegan and Sara.

episodes.title: Simpsley
episodes.description: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she's tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there's a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinners' clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust, and Italian lira abound in this Disney+ exclusive Simpsons noir.

episodes.title: Yellow Mirror
episodes.description: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre in this Disney+ exclusive episode.
